He warns her of an impendingapocalypseand offers to help her escape, but Eep elects to stay with the family. Guy leaves her a shell horn to blow if she needs help, but when Eep returns to her family, Grug and the others destroy the horn out of fear of the "New". An earthquake destroys the cave and surrounding lands, and the Croods flee into a jungle they discover below their home mountains. Encountering a "Macawnivore" (portmanteau of "macaw" and "carnivore"), aSaber-toothed Catwhom Eep's grandmother dubs "Chunky", the family flees him, until he is scared off by "piranhakeets" (portmanteau of "piranha" and "parakeet") that devour a groundwhale. Eep makes another horn and calls to Guy, who rescues them with his fire. After some confusion regarding the Croods'first contact with fire, Grug imprisons Guy in a log so he can guide them somewhere safe. To appease Grug, Guy suggests the Croods go to a mountain where there are caves, though in reality he and the other Croods doubt the wisdom of this. During the journey, Guy is eventually trusted enough to be allowed out of the log. Grug attempts to steal abird's egg for dinner, but catches ascorpioninstead, and Guy teaches Eep how to lay a trap for the bird itself. Guy endears himself to most of the Croods by inventing rudimentary shoes for the family, and other "ideas" which help them along the way. He also talks about "Tomorrow", a land of light where curiosity is not to be feared. Grug becomes jealous of Guy, especially after noticing he and Eep are falling in love. His disastrous attempts to fight against change, and to come up with inventions and ideas of his own, distance him from his family and cause his wife Ugga to argue with him.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 古鲁一家六口多年来一直隐居在深山洞穴，只在附近活动，从未见过更远的世界。某日小伊在晚上偷偷溜出去，结识了拥有许多先进点子的阿盖，阿盖告诉她世界即将面临末日的到来。之后在一场地震，古鲁一家的安乐窝倒塌了，他们被迫往外逃命。灿烂缤纷的外面世界对他们而言，彷如置身奇怪异域，起初十分不习惯，犹幸大家凭着无穷幽默及阿盖的点子，很快便结识到各款奇形怪状的搞怪动物朋友，令段段奇幻旅程充满更大挑战。疯狂原始人终于发现，未来日子里还有更多无数精彩欢乐冒险，等待他们七人逐一发掘。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 古魯一家六口多年來一直隱居在深山洞穴，只在附近活動，從未見過更遠的世界。某日阿葉在晚上偷偷溜出去，結識了擁有許多先進點子的阿怪，阿怪告訴她世界即將面臨末日的到來。之後在一場地震，古魯一家的安樂窩倒塌了，他們被迫往外逃命。燦爛繽紛的外面世界對他們而言，彷如置身奇怪異域，起初十分不習慣，猶幸大家憑着無窮幽默及阿怪的點子，很快便結識到各款奇形怪狀的搞怪動物朋友，令段段奇幻旅程充滿更大挑戰。古魯家族終於發現，未來日子裏還有更多無數精彩歡樂冒險，等待他們七人逐一發掘。

TITLE: The Host
PLOT SUMMARY: Small parasitic aliens called "Souls", who travel to planets inserting themselves into a host body of that planet's dominant species while suppressing the host's consciousness, have taken over the human race. Deeming humans too violent to deserve the planet, they have now almost successfully conquered Earth. The original owner's consciousness is erased, but the Souls can access the host's memories, and occupied hosts are identifiable by silver rings in their eyes. A human on the run, Melanie Stryder, is captured and infused with a Soul called ''Wanderer", whom a "Seeker" soul has asked to access Melanie's memories and learn the location of a pocket of unassimilated humans. Melanie's consciousness, however, has not been completely eliminated; she and Wanderer carry out an internal conversation and debate with each other, eventually becoming friends. Wanderer tells Seeker that Melanie was traveling with her brother, Jamie, and her boyfriend, Jared Howe, to find Melanie's uncle Jeb in the desert. Wanderer admits that Melanie is still present, so Seeker decides to be transferred into Melanie's body to get the information herself and will subsequently terminate Melanie. With Melanie’s guidance, Wanderer escapes to the desert, where Jeb finds her and takes her to a series of caves inside a mountain where the humans (including Jared and Jamie) are hiding.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 外星生物入侵地球后，寄生在人体内，控制心智，抹灭人性。寄生在梅兰妮(西尔莎·罗南饰演)身上的漫游者，虽然深知要控制人类心智，面临人类感情丰沛、过往的记忆鲜明，难以抵抗及驾驭，但仍旧毅然接受挑战。 只是漫游者万万没想到，梅兰妮抗拒让出她的心智，亦没有失去自我意思，反而与漫游者产生灵魂重叠。结果漫游者思绪里满是梅兰妮所爱的人的身影，那是一个仍未被外星生物入侵的男人。渐渐地，漫游者也爱上了这个男人。同一个躯壳中的两个灵魂，不甘愿地合作，一起找寻共同所爱的人。 原作提及寄生者的原貌类似水母，有许多触手。寄生时即是以触手连接宿主的神经，并取代其原本的意识，但是本体非常脆弱。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 外星生物入侵地球後，寄生在人體內，控制心智，抹滅人性。寄生在梅蘭妮(茜爾莎·羅倫飾演)身上的漫遊者，雖然深知要控制人類心智，面臨人類感情豐沛、過往的記憶鮮明，難以抵抗及駕馭，但仍舊毅然接受挑戰。 只是漫遊者萬萬沒想到，梅蘭妮抗拒讓出她的心智，亦沒有失去自我意思，反而與漫遊者產生靈魂重疊。結果漫遊者思緒裏滿是梅蘭妮所愛的人的身影，那是一個仍未被外星生物入侵的男人。漸漸地，漫遊者也愛上了這個男人。同一個軀殼中的兩個靈魂，不甘願地合作，一起找尋共同所愛的人。 原作提及寄生者的原貌類似水母，有許多觸手。寄生時即是以觸手連接天煞逆緣的神經，並取代其原本的意識，但是本體非常脆弱。

TITLE: The Place Beyond the Pines
PLOT SUMMARY: In 1994, Luke Glanton is a motorcycle stuntman with a traveling carnival. InSchenectady, he meets his ex-lover Romina Gutierrez, who is now with another man, Kofi Kancam. Luke discovers that he unknowingly fathered Romina's baby Jason the previous year. He leaves the carnival to stay near the mother and son. Luke begins working part-time for auto mechanic Robin Van Der Hook. When he asks for more work Robin reveals his past as a bank robber and suggests they commit robberies together. Luke robs the banks at gunpoint and gets away on his motorcycle which he rides into abox truckdriven by Robin. Despite Romina's protests, Luke forces a relatively small amount of money from one of the bank robberies on to Romina. Luke and Romina have sex in his trailer and he spends time with her and Jason. He lets himself into Romina and Kofi's house to assemble a crib for Jason. When Kofi demands he leave, Luke strikes him with a wrench and is arrested. Robin bails him out of jail and Luke says he wants to provide for Jason's future. Robin refuses to do any more robberies and the pair fall out. Robin dismantles Luke's motorcycle, so Luke robs him to buy a new one.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 卢克（瑞恩·高斯林饰）是一个习惯于独来独往的机车赛手，他的过去相当的神秘莫测且难以捉摸，由于他被驱逐出了带有环游世界性质的赛车嘉年华，结果也使得他重新回到了纽约相对贫穷的斯卡奈塔第，想尽一切办法想要和他曾经的情人罗米娜（伊娃·门德斯饰）再续前缘，因为他刚刚获悉，在他们分开一年后，罗米娜生下了他的儿子。为了养家糊口，卢克决定退出赛车生涯，然后通过他娴熟的摩托车技能，实施了一系列抢劫银行的犯罪计划，因为这是他所能想到的惟一可以赚大钱的办法。 然而，当卢克与非常有野心的警察艾弗里·克罗斯（布莱德利·库珀饰）产生了正面的冲突与碰撞之后，他也开始意识到，自己需要为此付出的代价与承担的危险正在成倍地上涨。作为一名新手警官，摆在艾弗里面前的是大好的前程与仕途，即使他身处的是一个已经被贪污腐败彻底地侵蚀的警察局，却并不能阻止他去追寻属于他自己的未来，可以说是非常的顺利，而且一路畅通无阻，结果在他遭遇了卢克的时候，却全部受到了前所未有的考验，并围绕着他们发展出了一个覆盖范围非常广泛且极其跌宕起伏的故事— —跨度超过15年，描述的全部是来自于过去的罪孽与过失，是如何影响并渗透进他们现在的生活的。 两个在同一所高中念书的少年，都因为他们不得不去传承的血统与宿命，而不断地纠结著、挣扎著，想方设法地要摆脱这种命运的怪圈——对于他们来说，他们所能找到的惟一的庇护所，也许就在“松林之外”的某个地方。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 盧克（賴恩·高斯寧飾）是一個習慣於獨來獨往的機車賽手，他的過去相當的神秘莫測且難以捉摸，由於他被驅逐出了帶有環遊世界性質的賽車嘉年華，結果也使得他重新回到了紐約相對貧窮的斯卡奈塔第，想盡一切辦法想要和他曾經的情人羅米娜（伊娃·文迪絲飾）再續前緣，因為他剛剛獲悉，在他們分開一年後，羅米娜生下了他的兒子。為了養家餬口，盧克決定退出賽車生涯，然後通過他嫻熟的摩托車技能，實施了一系列搶劫銀行的犯罪計劃，因為這是他所能想到的惟一可以賺大錢的辦法。 然而，當盧克與非常有野心的警察艾弗里·克羅斯（畢列·谷巴飾）產生了正面的衝突與碰撞之後，他也開始意識到，自己需要為此付出的代價與承擔的危險正在成倍地上漲。作為一名新手警官，擺在艾弗裏面前的是大好的前程與仕途，即使他身處的是一個已經被貪污腐敗徹底地侵蝕的警察局，卻並不能阻止他去追尋屬於他自己的未來，可以說是非常的順利，而且一路暢通無阻，結果在他遭遇了盧克的時候，卻全部受到了前所未有的考驗，並圍繞着他們發展出了一個覆蓋範圍非常廣泛且極其跌宕起伏的故事— —跨度超過15年，描述的全部是來自於過去的罪孽與過失，是如何影響並滲透進他們現在的生活的。 兩個在同一所高中唸書的少年，都因為他們不得不去傳承的血統與宿命，而不斷地糾結著、掙扎著，想方設法地要擺脫這種命運的怪圈——對於他們來說，他們所能找到的惟一的庇護所，也許就在「松林之外」的某個地方。

TITLE: Oblivion
PLOT SUMMARY: In 2017, aliens known as Scavengers attack Earth and destroy the Moon, triggering global natural disasters. Although humanity wins the war using nuclear weapons, Earth is left uninhabitable. Sixty years later, the remnants of humanity have relocated to a colony onSaturn's moonTitan, except for Unit 49—technician Jack and his communications officer Victoria—who are scheduled to join them in two weeks. The pair oversee hydro rigs that convert seawater into fusion energy for the Tet, the last remaining human colony ship in orbit. Though Jack and Victoria are romantically involved and have had their memories erased for security reasons, Jack experiences recurring dreams of an unknown woman. He also secretly visits a hidden, verdant valley where he has built a lakeside cabin and collects relics of Earth's past. While investigating a missing drone—autonomous, highly advanced, and heavily armed machines—Jack is nearly captured by Scavengers. Later, he discovers the Scavengers are transmitting a signal into space. ANASApod crash-lands at the signal's coordinates, carrying five humans in suspended animation, including the woman from Jack's dreams. A drone arrives and destroys four of the pods, but Jack rescues the remaining one and brings the unconscious woman to Unit 49's base.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 2017年，未知的外星机器“锥形舰”入侵地球掌控世界，将地球两名精英杰克·哈伯（汤姆·克鲁斯饰演）和维多莉亚·欧森（安德丽娅·赖斯伯勒饰演）大量复制并植入记忆，虚构了一个2077年地球战胜外星人后，地球已不适居住，人类移居泰坦星的情节。哈伯担任驻扎在地球49号塔台的维修技师，负责维护抽取海水的机器。欧森担任通讯官及哈伯之妻，负责和地球轨道上的“锥形舰”太空站连络。两人来地球前都基于安全因素被洗掉了记忆，但哈伯时常梦见自己和一位女子在一橦大楼上。少数存活的外星人则仍不放弃夺掠地球的剩余资源，因此塔台也派出侦察机巡逻。 再过两星期，哈伯和欧森将完成任务，前往泰坦星与其他幸存者会合。这一天，外星人透过一橦大楼向太空发出了讯号，讯号内容是一个GPS坐标(41.146576,-73.975739)。哈伯前往大楼并切断了讯号，却发现这大楼和他梦中的大楼一样。不久，一架太空船“漫游号”坠毁在该坐标，赶到现场的哈伯发现太空船上的存活者是地球人，而且理应保护人类的侦察机竟开始杀害存活者。哈伯救了一位曾不断在他梦中出现的女性，茱丽雅·鲁萨可娃（奥尔加·库里连科饰演），并带回和欧森同住的49号塔台治疗。 隔天，哈伯和鲁萨可娃试图取回黑盒子，却被外星人捕捉。这时哈伯才发现所谓的外星人全是人类。这群人类的领袖麦考·毕区（摩根·弗里曼饰演）说侦察机的功能就是杀害人类，并要求哈伯修复一台侦察机，以便将炸弹送至锥形舰。哈伯拒绝，毕区却放走哈伯和鲁萨可娃。哈伯带鲁萨可娃回到大楼，送出讯号请欧森派直升机前来载送他回到住所，此时他回忆起自己的记忆，鲁萨可娃也确认这不是梦。原来鲁萨可娃和哈伯是夫妻，两人一同出太空任务要观察外星人的锥形舰，而欧森也是船上的一名太空人。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 2017年，未知的外星機器「錐形艦」入侵地球掌控世界，將地球兩名精英傑克·哈伯（湯·告魯斯飾演）和維多莉亞·歐森（安哲雅·麗絲布洛飾演）大量複製並植入記憶，虛構了一個2077年地球戰勝外星人後，地球已不適居住，人類移居泰坦星的情節。哈伯擔任駐紮在地球49號塔台的維修技師，負責維護抽取海水的機器。歐森擔任通訊官及哈伯之妻，負責和地球軌道上的「錐形艦」太空站連絡。兩人來地球前都基於安全因素被洗掉了記憶，但哈伯時常夢見自己和一位女子在一橦大樓上。少數存活的外星人則仍不放棄奪掠地球的剩餘資源，因此塔台也派出偵察機巡邏。 再過兩星期，哈伯和歐森將完成任務，前往泰坦星與其他倖存者會合。這一天，外星人透過一橦大樓向太空發出了訊號，訊號內容是一個GPS座標(41.146576,-73.975739)。哈伯前往大樓並切斷了訊號，卻發現這大樓和他夢中的大樓一樣。不久，一架太空船「漫遊號」墜毀在該座標，趕到現場的哈伯發現太空船上的存活者是地球人，而且理應保護人類的偵察機竟開始殺害存活者。哈伯救了一位曾不斷在他夢中出現的女性，茱麗雅·魯薩可娃（奧嘉·古莉寧高飾演），並帶回和歐森同住的49號塔台治療。 隔天，哈伯和魯薩可娃試圖取回黑盒子，卻被外星人捕捉。這時哈伯才發現所謂的外星人全是人類。這群人類的領袖麥考·畢區（摩根·費曼飾演）說偵察機的功能就是殺害人類，並要求哈伯修復一台偵察機，以便將炸彈送至錐形艦。哈伯拒絕，畢區卻放走哈伯和魯薩可娃。哈伯帶魯薩可娃回到大樓，送出訊號請歐森派直升機前來載送他回到住所，此時他回憶起自己的記憶，魯薩可娃也確認這不是夢。原來魯薩可娃和哈伯是夫妻，兩人一同出太空任務要觀察外星人的錐形艦，而歐森也是船上的一名太空人。

TITLE: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
TITLE (HK): 義勇群英之毒蛇反擊戰
PLOT SUMMARY: Special Forces team commanderDukeleads theG.I. Joe Teamto theKorean Demilitarized Zoneto rescue a North Korean defector. They are then assigned another mission to steal nuclear warheads fromPakistanafter the death ofits Presidentduring a civil war. Deeming them as traitors for causing an international incident,Zartan, still impersonating thepresident of the United States, calls an airstrike that kills Duke and many Joes. Heavy machine gunnerRoadblock, sniperFlint, and covert operatorLady Jayesurvive the attack by diving into a well, and they return to the United States to contactGeneral Joseph Colton, who provides them with weapons. Meanwhile,Storm Shadow, who survived the Arctic base's destruction,[a]and demolitions expertFireflyrescueCobra Commanderfrom an underground maximum-security prison inGermany, leavingDestrobehind. Storm Shadow is injured and retreats to a temple in theHimalayasto recover. The Blind Master, leader of theArashikageClan, sendsSnake Eyesand his apprenticeJinx, to capture Storm Shadow, allowing him to answer for the murder of his uncle, theHard Master. After Zartan announces that Cobra will become the premier U.S. special forces team, replacing G.I. Joe, Lady Jaye deduces that someone is impersonating the President by noting changes in his speech patterns. At a presidential fundraiser, she steals a sample of the President's DNA, confirming that he is Zartan. They escape after a confrontation with Firefly andZandar, the head of theU.S. Secret Service's Presidential Detail and a member of Cobra.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 距离第一集，眼镜蛇的核心人物指挥官、戴斯卓及男爵夫人等被擒获之后，特种部队上尉公爵以及他麾下的许多成员继续了之后追捕尚逃离并失踪的撒旦以及其他的反恐任务。而伪装成美国总统的撒旦企图以自己的相貌统治世界，在向真正的总统问出指挥官和戴斯卓的下落、控制住了所有国家的元首后准备展开下一步行动。在一次巴基斯坦的阻止核试验基地任务以及巴基斯坦的总统刺杀报复行动后，特种部队团队突然遭到大规模攻击而忙乱不已。这场攻击造成了隧道鼠（Tunnel Rat）、鼠仔还有公爵的死亡。仅有路霸、火石还有珍生还。 另一方面，在东德的一座秘密监狱中，军方抓到了疑似刺杀巴基斯坦总统的刺客“蛇眼”，并将其和眼镜蛇指挥官、戴斯卓关在水牢中，后来发现这个蛇眼其实是上一集被认定已死的雷影。同时，眼镜蛇中的神秘人物萤火虫于监狱外放出了无数的机械萤火虫并将监狱炸的分崩离析，雷影和眼镜蛇指挥从中逃出，并不理会戴斯卓，指挥官还说戴斯卓让他失望并和雷影离去，进行更恐怖的阴谋，蛇眼及时赶到现场，把所看到的记录下来，雷影被送到喜马拉雅山上治疗，而指挥官和萤火虫回到基地，继续完成新武器“宙斯钨棒卫星”，决定在核武高峰会上使用。 生还下来路霸、火石和珍回到美国，并利用路霸的关系找了间他以前曾使用过的健身房作为基地。在电视转播上，伪装成总统的撒旦宣布特种部队是罪魁祸首，因此将眼镜蛇取代特种部队。珍怀疑现任的总统是假的，因此三人决定要前去确认清楚，在这之前路霸提议先去找特种部队元老柯尔顿将军，柯尔顿在听从他们的想法后提供了武器，并帮助他们潜入总统的筹款活动。当珍取得总统的毛发样本后，路霸确认总统就是撒旦；这时，对方却发现了他们的行动。路霸本打算在大门口将撒旦解决，但却反被萤火虫袭击，所幸火石和珍及时抵达才救了路霸，而萤火虫则随即逃跑。同一时间，眼镜蛇的赞达、萤火虫和指挥官扫描了真正总统的瞳孔，取得核弹发射的控制权。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 距離第一集，眼鏡蛇的核心人物指揮官、戴斯卓及男爵夫人等被擒獲之後，特種部隊上尉公爵以及他麾下的許多成員繼續了之後追捕尚逃離並失蹤的撒旦以及其他的反恐任務。而偽裝成美國總統的撒旦企圖以自己的相貌統治世界，在向真正的總統問出指揮官和戴斯卓的下落、控制住了所有國家的元首後準備展開下一步行動。在一次巴基斯坦的阻止核試驗基地任務以及巴基斯坦的總統刺殺報復行動後，特種部隊團隊突然遭到大規模攻擊而忙亂不已。這場攻擊造成了隧道鼠（Tunnel Rat）、鼠仔還有公爵的死亡。僅有路霸、火石還有珍生還。 另一方面，在東德的一座秘密監獄中，軍方抓到了疑似刺殺巴基斯坦總統的刺客「蛇眼」，並將其和眼鏡蛇指揮官、戴斯卓關在水牢中，後來發現這個蛇眼其實是上一集被認定已死的雷影。同時，眼鏡蛇中的神秘人物螢火蟲於監獄外放出了無數的機械螢火蟲並將監獄炸的分崩離析，雷影和眼鏡蛇指揮從中逃出，並不理會戴斯卓，指揮官還說戴斯卓讓他失望並和雷影離去，進行更恐怖的陰謀，蛇眼及時趕到現場，把所看到的記錄下來，雷影被送到喜馬拉雅山上治療，而指揮官和螢火蟲回到基地，繼續完成新武器「宙斯鎢棒衛星」，決定在核武高峰會上使用。 生還下來路霸、火石和珍回到美國，並利用路霸的關係找了間他以前曾使用過的健身房作為基地。在電視轉播上，偽裝成總統的撒旦宣布特種部隊是罪魁禍首，因此將眼鏡蛇取代特種部隊。珍懷疑現任的總統是假的，因此三人決定要前去確認清楚，在這之前路霸提議先去找特種部隊元老柯爾頓將軍，柯爾頓在聽從他們的想法後提供了武器，並幫助他們潛入總統的籌款活動。當珍取得總統的毛髮樣本後，路霸確認總統就是撒旦；這時，對方卻發現了他們的行動。路霸本打算在大門口將撒旦解決，但卻反被螢火蟲襲擊，所幸火石和珍及時抵達才救了路霸，而螢火蟲則隨即逃跑。同一時間，眼鏡蛇的贊達、螢火蟲和指揮官掃描了真正總統的瞳孔，取得核彈發射的控制權。

TITLE: Pain & Gain
PLOT SUMMARY: In 1994, ex-con andbodybuilderDaniel Lugo is hired by Sun Gym owner John Mese as a manager. Lugo befriends trainer and bodybuilder Adrian Doorbal, who was recently renderedimpotentfrom steroids. He envies the earnings and lifestyle of Victor Kershaw, a member he begins to train. Inspired to be a "doer" by motivational speaker/playboy Jonny Wu, Lugo plans toextortKershaw for his assets. He recruits Doorbal, who seeks financial resources to pay forerectile dysfunctiontreatment. He manipulates Paul Doyle, another ex-con andborn again Christianstruggling with drug use, into joining the plan. Doyle, who had been staying at a church after leaving prison, assaults the priest at the church for making homosexual advances on him and becomes more intertwined with the gang. The "Sun Gym gang" kidnaps Kershaw, taking him to a small warehouse. Although Kershaw identifies Lugo, the scheme proceeds as planned. Under duress, Kershaw makes calls to provide explanations for his disappearance and transfers his assets to Lugo. Mese is bribed tonotarizedocuments in Kershaw's absence. After collecting Kershaw's money and assets, the gang attempts to kill Kershaw. They stage a drunk driving crash, burn his car, then run him over. The gang members spoil themselves with Kershaw's riches. Lugo takes over Kershaw's car and home and begins integrating himself with Kershaw's neighbors; Doorbal marries Robin, the nurse treating his impotence; Doyle abandons his sobriety, blowing his money on cocaine and Sorina, who is a stripper and Lugo's ex-girlfriend who believes he and Lugo work for theCIA.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 丹尼尔·卢戈（Daniel Lugo，马克·沃尔伯格饰演）是名阴谋家，因为实行医疗保险欺诈而被捕入狱，最近被释放出来。 太阳健身房的老板约翰·梅斯（John Mese，罗伯·考德瑞饰演）雇佣卢戈为健身教练。卢戈在六个星期内与阿德里安·道伯尔（Adrian Doorbal，安东尼·麦凯饰演），一个使用大量类固醇而出现性功能障碍的健美运动员结为好友。在影片的开头，卢戈为摆脱警察的追捕逃亡，想不到，被一辆警车撞倒。然后视线转回几个月前，在通过赢得大量会员来进行训练开始自己的生活方式后，卢戈变得贪婪，期间他遇见了认为自己是骗子的维克多·克肖（Victor Kershaw，托尼·舍卢卜饰演）。卢戈受到了强尼·吴（Jonny Wu，郑肯饰演）一番激励人心演讲启发后，决定拟定计划通过绑架和虐待的手段赢取维克多的家财。 随后，卢戈还招收因吸毒大量可卡因而被捕，信奉基督教并在最近被释放的保罗·多伊尔（Paul Doyle，道恩·强森饰演）。一开始保罗并不愿意加入，但后来与他与牧师发生了激烈的争吵，致使他回心转意。这个“太阳健身团伙”没能成功在维克多的家里将其绑架，最终在一家熟食店外用电击枪将其拿下，并带他到他自己的小仓库中。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 丹尼爾·盧戈（Daniel Lugo，麥克·華堡飾演）是名陰謀家，因為實行醫療保險欺詐而被捕入獄，最近被釋放出來。 太陽健身房的老闆約翰·梅斯（John Mese，羅伯·考德瑞飾演）僱傭盧戈為健身教練。盧戈在六個星期內與阿德里安·道伯爾（Adrian Doorbal，安東尼·麥奇飾演），一個使用大量類固醇而出現性功能障礙的健美運動員結為好友。在影片的開頭，盧戈為擺脫警察的追捕逃亡，想不到，被一輛警車撞倒。然後視線轉回幾個月前，在通過贏得大量會員來進行訓練開始自己的生活方式後，盧戈變得貪婪，期間他遇見了認為自己是騙子的維克多·克肖（Victor Kershaw，東尼·蘇侯比飾演）。盧戈受到了強尼·吳（Jonny Wu，鄭肯飾演）一番激勵人心演講啟發後，決定擬定計劃通過綁架和虐待的手段贏取維克多的家財。 隨後，盧戈還招收因吸毒大量可卡因而被捕，信奉基督教並在最近被釋放的保羅·多伊爾（Paul Doyle，狄維·莊遜飾演）。一開始保羅並不願意加入，但後來與他與牧師發生了激烈的爭吵，致使他回心轉意。這個「太陽健身團伙」沒能成功在維克多的家裏將其綁架，最終在一家熟食店外用電擊槍將其拿下，並帶他到他自己的小倉庫中。

TITLE: Star Trek Into Darkness
PLOT SUMMARY: In 2259, CaptainJames T. Kirkis removed from command of the starshipUSSEnterprisefor violating thePrime Directiveby revealing the ship to the primitive inhabitants of the planet Nibiru to save them, and Spock, from a cataclysmic volcanic eruption. AdmiralChristopher Pikeis reinstated as commanding officer, and Kirk is demoted to first officer.Spockis transferred to another ship. Shortly after, Starfleet officer Thomas Harewood, sent by Commander John Harrison, bombs aSection 31installation inLondon. During an emergency meeting on the situation, Harrison uses a ship to ambush and kill Pike and other senior officers, before transporting toKronos, the homeworld of the hostileKlingons. Admiral Alexander Marcus reinstates Kirk and Spock to theEnterprisewith orders to kill Harrison using a new long-range stealth torpedo. Chief EngineerMontgomery Scottobjects to allowing untested torpedoes on board without knowing their specifications; when he is overruled, he resigns. Kirk assignsPavel Chekovto replace Scotty. En route to Kronos,Enterprise's warp capabilities become disabled. Kirk leads a team with Spock andUhurato the planet, where Klingon patrols ambush them. Harrison appears and kills the Klingons. Harrison surrenders when he learns the precise number of torpedoes on boardEnterprise. Dr.Leonard McCoyand Marcus's daughter, Dr.Carol Marcus, open a torpedo at Harrison's urging, revealing the torpedoes containcryonically frozenhumans. Harrison is taken toEnterprise's brig, where he reveals his true identity asKhan Noonien Singh, a genetically engineered superhuman who was awoken by Admiral Marcus from centuries of sleep and forced to develop advanced weapons after threatening to kill his crew, whom he smuggled into the torpedoes. Khan reveals that Marcus sabotagedEnterprise's warp drive, intending for the Klingons to destroy the ship after it fired on Kronos, sparking a war with the Klingon Empire. Khan also gives Kirk a set of coordinates, which Kirk asks Scott to investigate. Scott discovers the coordinates lead to a covert Starfleet facility.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 进取号于尼比鲁星系执行观察任务时，为了避免一座即将爆发的大型火山摧毁整座星球，决定冒险将火山透过大型冷冻装置冻结。然而，过程中由于失误而造成史波克被困于火山中心，为了将他救出来，舰长柯克奋不顾身地违反星际联邦的最高守则，将整艘进取号飞到火山顶端将史波克传送回船上，过程也使得巨大的进取号整体暴露给星球居民。返航地球后，柯克因史波克的如实汇报而被联邦解除舰长职务，进取号由上将兼前任舰长克里斯多佛·派克（英语：Christopher Pike (Star Trek)）重新担任，柯克受降职成为大副，而史波克则被调职至其他舰船。 联邦位于伦敦的一座机密武器部门31区发生爆炸恐怖袭击，主凶是一位叛逃的联邦特务约翰·哈里森。柯克、史波克和派克参与联邦总部召开的紧急会议期间，哈里森开一艘小型舰艇袭击会议室，派克于期间不幸重伤身亡，而柯克想办法损坏舰艇后，哈里森用携带式曲速传送装置逃亡至克林贡帝国统治的“克罗诺斯星系”。为了找寻哈里森来为派克复仇，柯克靠联邦上将亚历山大·马库斯重任舰长一职，召集史波克在内的所有船员开进取号前往克罗诺斯。为了避免克林贡和联邦的战争，马库斯命令柯克要利用31区研制的数十颗新型无轨迹光子鱼雷，在不被克林贡人发现的情况下狙杀哈里森。但轮机长蒙哥马利·斯科特不相信这些来源及发射效果皆不明的鱼雷而拒绝签收，与执意要复仇的柯克发生意见冲突后便辞职以示抗议。 航行过程中，顶替轮机长职位的帕夫·契科夫不慎导致进取号的曲速核心故障，被迫停驶在克林贡帝国中立区域边界旁。柯克留下苏鲁光指挥进取号，带领史波克和乌乎拉前往抓捕哈里森，并用鱼雷威胁哈里森束手就擒。然而，柯克一行人碰上克林贡巡逻队，在寡不敌众之下即将被歼灭，但哈里森现身杀光整个巡逻队救下他们，得知鱼雷总共有72颗后弃械投降。哈里森被收押回进取号，声言鱼雷中隐藏黑幕，而当时为了探查鱼雷真相而隐瞒真实身份登舰的马库斯上将之女卡萝·马库斯，自告奋勇和总医官伦纳德·麦科伊想办法打开一颗鱼雷，两人发现内部躺着一名沉睡在冬眠舱中的人。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 企業號於尼比魯星系執行觀察任務時，為了避免一座即將爆發的大型火山摧毀整座星球，決定冒險將火山透過大型冷凍裝置凍結。然而，過程中由於失誤而造成冼樸被困於火山中心，為了將他救出來，艦長卻克奮不顧身地違反星際聯邦的最高守則，將整艘企業號飛到火山頂端將冼樸傳送回船上，過程也使得巨大的企業號整體暴露給星球居民。返航地球後，卻克因冼樸的如實匯報而被聯邦解除艦長職務，企業號由上將兼前任艦長克里斯多佛·派克（英語：Christopher Pike (Star Trek)）重新擔任，卻克受降職成為大副，而冼樸則被調職至其他艦船。 聯邦位於倫敦的一座機密武器部門31區發生爆炸恐怖襲擊，主兇是一位叛逃的聯邦特務約翰·夏里遜。卻克、冼樸和派克參與聯邦總部召開的緊急會議期間，夏里遜開一艘小型艦艇襲擊會議室，派克於期間不幸重傷身亡，而卻克想辦法損壞艦艇後，夏里遜用攜帶式曲速傳送裝置逃亡至克林崗帝國統治的「克羅諾斯星系」。為了找尋夏里遜來為派克復仇，卻克靠聯邦上將亞歴山大·馬庫斯重任艦長一職，召集冼樸在內的所有船員開企業號前往克羅諾斯。為了避免克林崗和聯邦的戰爭，馬庫斯命令卻克要利用31區研製的數十顆新型無軌跡光子魚雷，在不被克林崗人發現的情況下狙殺夏里遜。但輪機長蒙哥馬利·史葛不相信這些來源及發射效果皆不明的魚雷而拒絕簽收，與執意要復仇的卻克發生意見衝突後便辭職以示抗議。 航行過程中，頂替輪機長職位的帕夫·契科夫不慎導致企業號的曲速核心故障，被迫停駛在克林崗帝國中立區域邊界旁。卻克留下蘇魯光指揮企業號，帶領冼樸和烏乎拉前往抓捕夏里遜，並用魚雷威脅夏里遜束手就擒。然而，卻克一行人碰上克林崗巡邏隊，在寡不敵眾之下即將被殲滅，但夏里遜現身殺光整個巡邏隊救下他們，得知魚雷總共有72顆後棄械投降。夏里遜被收押回企業號，聲言魚雷中隱藏黑幕，而當時為了探查魚雷真相而隱瞞真實身份登艦的馬庫斯上將之女卡蘿·馬庫斯，自告奮勇和總醫官倫納德·麥哥想辦法打開一顆魚雷，兩人發現內部躺着一名沉睡在冬眠艙中的人。

TITLE: After Earth
PLOT SUMMARY: In the future on a human-populated space colony, Nova Prime, the S'krellextraterrestrial raceattempts to take it over with creatures called Ursas, which hunt by "sensing" fear despite being technically blind. Humanity created a peacekeeping military organization, The Ranger Corps, to fight the threat. Their leader, General Cypher Raige, defeats the Ursas with a fear-suppressing technique he called "ghosting". Cypher's daughter, Senshi, was killed during an Ursa assault. Blaming himself for his sister's death, Senshi's 14-year-old brother Kitai trains to become a Ranger like Cypher but is rejected. Kitai's mother Faia convinces Cypher to take their son on his last mission before he retires. He takes The Ranger Corps off planet to train with a live Ursa, which is tied and immobilized in their spaceship. During flight, the ship is caught in an asteroid shower, causing them to crash-land on Earth, now a desolate and uninhabited planet which humans had evacuated a thousand years earlier due to an environmental cataclysm. Cypher and Kitai survived the crash, but Cypher's legs are broken, and the main beacon for firing a distress signal is damaged. Cypher instructs Kitai to locate the tail section of the ship, which broke off on entry to the atmosphere. Inside is the backup beacon, which they can use to signal Nova Prime. Cypher gives Kitai his weaponized cutlass, a wrist communicator, and six capsules of a fluid that enhances oxygen intake so he can breathe. Kitai leaves to find the tail section, with Cypher guiding him through the communicator.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 因千年前的巨变，人类被迫离开地球迁往诺瓦星定居。 而一千年后，由Cypher Raige将军指挥的维和组织Ranger Corps与想征服诺瓦星的外星生物S'krell发生冲突。后者的秘密武器是一种大型掠夺性生物，名为Ursas，他们通过“感知恐惧”来捕杀敌人。Ranger Corps的游骑兵一直与Ursas斗争，直到Cypher将军学会如何完全压制对Ursas的恐惧，这项技术称为“重影”，Cypher将军向其他游骑兵传授这项技术，于是维和组织Ranger Crops取得了胜利。 与此同时，Cypher将军的儿子Kitai Raige因为姐姐Senshi 死于Ursas之手而自责。Kitai想要受训成为像父亲一样的游骑兵，但由于鲁莽而失败，令 Cypher将军感到很失望。Kitai的母亲 Faia 说服 Cypher 在退休前的最后一次航行中和 Kitai 修补父子关系。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 因千年前的巨變，人類被迫離開地球遷往諾瓦星定居。 而一千年後，由Cypher Raige將軍指揮的維和組織Ranger Corps與想征服諾瓦星的外星生物S'krell發生衝突。後者的秘密武器是一種大型掠奪性生物，名為Ursas，他們通過「感知恐懼」來捕殺敵人。Ranger Corps的遊騎兵一直與Ursas鬥爭，直到Cypher將軍學會如何完全壓制對Ursas的恐懼，這項技術稱為「重影」，Cypher將軍向其他遊騎兵傳授這項技術，於是維和組織Ranger Crops取得了勝利。 與此同時，Cypher將軍的兒子Kitai Raige因為姊姊Senshi 死於Ursas之手而自責。Kitai想要受訓成為像父親一樣的遊騎兵，但由於魯莽而失敗，令 Cypher將軍感到很失望。Kitai的母親 Faia 說服 Cypher 在退休前的最後一次航行中和 Kitai 修補父子關係。

TITLE: Frances Ha
PLOT SUMMARY: Frances is a 27-year-old dancer who lives inNew York Citywith her best friend from college, Sophie. Her life is upended when Sophie tells her she plans to relocate fromBrooklyntoTribeca, which Sophie considers her dream neighborhood, with a different friend. Frances, a struggling would-be dancer working as an apprentice at a dance company, is unable to afford the Brooklyn apartment alone and is forced to find someplace else to live. She moves toChinatownand shares an apartment with her friends Lev and Benji for a brief period. Sophie and Frances's relationship struggles as Sophie and her boyfriend, Patch, grow closer. Frances learns that the dance company does not need her to work their Christmas show, which means Frances can no longer afford the apartment. She visits her hometown ofSacramentoforChristmaswhere she sees her family and reconnects with high school friends. Rachel, a fellow dancer in the company, lets Frances stay with her for a few weeks. During dinner with Rachel's family, Frances discovers that Sophie has quit her job atRandom Houseand is moving toTokyowith Patch. Frances, on a whim, decides to spend an uneventful couple of days inParisthat she pays for with a credit card. She returns toVassar, heralma mater, to work as a waitress and summerresident assistant. Overworked and not allowed to take classes, Frances reads Sophie's blog of her life in Tokyo.

TITLE: Now You See Me
PLOT SUMMARY: Four highly talented magicians—J. Daniel Atlas, Merritt McKinney, Henley Reeves, and Jack Wilder—each receive atarot cardleading them to an apartment in New York City. There, they discoverholographicinstructions from an unknown benefactor. A year later, inLas Vegas, they perform as "The Four Horsemen" in a show funded by insurance magnate Arthur Tressler. Their final trick involves transporting an audience member inside a Crédit Républicain bank vault in Paris. Stacks ofeuroare drawn into the vault's air vents and showered on the crowd; the trick appears to have happened as the Paris vault is found empty of its recent shipment. TheFBIandInterpolarrest the Horsemen but release them for lack of evidence. FBI agent Dylan Rhodes and French Interpol detective Alma Dray consult with Thaddeus Bradley, a former magician-turned-debunker, who deduces that the Horsemen used a mock vault under the stage, stole the real money in advance, and replaced it withflash paperresembling the cash. The flash paper burned when the vents were activated, leaving no smoke or residue. They also hypnotized the participant, chosen before the heist, to help with the final trick and forged his signature using his credit card. With Thaddeus's help, the FBI tracks the Horsemen to a show inNew Orleans, where they transfer millions from Tressler's accounts to audience members who were denied insurance claims followingHurricane Katrina. Dylan tries to capture them but fails. Furious, Tressler hires Thaddeus to expose the Horsemen for robbing him. Meanwhile, Alma suspects they are performing the heists as an initiation to a secret group, "the Eye", consisting of magicians who steal from the powerful to aid the vulnerable and instill hope. The FBI discovers that the Horsemen replaced Dylan's phone with abugged cloneto stay ahead in the investigation. They track Dylan's real phone to a New York apartment, where three Horsemen escape while Jack stays behind to destroy evidence. Jack crashes his car during a chase, seemingly dying.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 丹尼（杰西·艾森伯格饰演）、梅利（伍迪·哈里森饰演）、海妮（艾拉·菲舍尔饰演）、杰克（戴夫·弗兰科饰演）各自经营着自己的魔术把戏，一天突然收到一张印有天眼的卡片，邀请他们到纽约，在来到指定地点的机关屋后，机关展示了一系列魔术表演计划，指示他们准备执行这套表演计划。 一年之后，以丹尼领衔的四人组成“天启四骑士”魔术师团，在亚瑟·崔斯勒（迈克尔·凯恩饰演）的赞助下，在赌城拉斯维加斯进行魔术表演，他们随机抽取一名现场观众来协助表演洗劫巴黎信贷共和银行，在众目睽睽下，人们看见银行保险库的纸币被通风管抽到来现场，而另一边的银行的确发生保险柜的纸币不翼而飞的状况。这场表演惊动了联邦调查局，迪伦（马克·鲁法洛饰演）被指派调查此事，同时国际刑警组织从法国指派了艾尔玛（梅拉妮·罗兰饰演）协助调查，迪伦不相信魔术，但艾尔玛对魔术及“四骑士”背后的“天眼”很有兴趣。迪伦将四人逮捕并进行审讯，但反而遭到他们嘲弄，由于证据不足而最终释放。这时联邦调查局留意到一个专门经营揭秘魔术节目的赛迪斯（摩根·弗里曼饰演）也在现场，迪伦找到他，赛迪斯告诉迪伦“四骑士”是怎样提前布局引诱那位现场观众来现场并被选出，如何提前将给银行的钱掉包并将假钱最终销毁。 之后“四骑士”和亚瑟坐私人飞机前往新奥尔良准备第二场演出，艾尔玛与迪伦跟随其后，迪伦对利用别人缺点的魔术师很厌恶，但艾尔玛认为魔术能给人快乐。到了现场，联邦调查局布控监视，亚瑟警告赛迪斯不要阻碍“四骑士”的演出但不成功。艾尔玛提起了一个著名魔术师莱诺·谢克是如何将卡片“变进”树里，和其意外身亡的那次保险箱沉河逃脱表演中并没有找到尸体。“四骑士”开始他们的第二场表演，在一系列前置表演后，“四骑士”挑选了一批观众，说道他们手上有一个信封，上面有张纸写上了他们在银行的存款金额，之后他们还邀请亚瑟来到舞台，同样准备一张纸，写上了他拥有的存款金额，在他们的表演下，亚瑟的金额在减少而观众的在增加，不久后观众的手机收到了银行的存款变动信息，联邦调查局也证实了资金变动，这时“四骑士”揭露了他们实际是亚瑟旗下的崔斯勒保险的客户，由于一次灾难中蒙受损失，但被崔斯勒保险克扣了保险赔付，所以他们“替天行道”并且令亚瑟蒙羞（实际上在飞机上套取了亚瑟的安全问题信息而实施成功）。在联邦调查局的围捕下，“四骑士”还是逃过围捕。恼羞成怒的亚瑟决定资助赛迪斯来帮手抓住“四骑士”。迪伦一时间怀疑艾尔玛是内应，但冷静下来后，听了作为研究人员的艾尔玛提到关于魔术师所信奉的“天眼”的传说，也意外发现自己的手机被调包并知道他们去到了纽约。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 丹尼（謝西·艾辛堡飾演）、梅利（活地·夏里遜飾演）、海妮（艾娜·費莎飾演）、傑克（戴夫·法蘭高飾演）各自經營着自己的魔術把戲，一天突然收到一張印有天眼的卡片，邀請他們到紐約，在來到指定地點的機關屋後，機關展示了一系列魔術表演計劃，指示他們準備執行這套表演計劃。 一年之後，以丹尼領銜的四人組成「天啟四騎士」魔術師團，在亞瑟·崔斯勒（米高·堅飾演）的贊助下，在賭城拉斯維加斯進行魔術表演，他們隨機抽取一名現場觀眾來協助表演洗劫巴黎信貸共和銀行，在眾目睽睽下，人們看見銀行保險庫的紙幣被通風管抽到來現場，而另一邊的銀行的確發生保險櫃的紙幣不翼而飛的狀況。這場表演驚動了聯邦調查局，迪倫（麥克·雷法路飾演）被指派調查此事，同時國際刑警組織從法國指派了艾爾瑪（瑪麗蓮·洛倫飾演）協助調查，迪倫不相信魔術，但艾爾瑪對魔術及「四騎士」背後的「天眼」很有興趣。迪倫將四人逮捕並進行審訊，但反而遭到他們嘲弄，由於證據不足而最終釋放。這時聯邦調查局留意到一個專門經營揭秘魔術節目的賽迪斯（摩根·費曼飾演）也在現場，迪倫找到他，賽迪斯告訴迪倫「四騎士」是怎樣提前布局引誘那位現場觀眾來現場並被選出，如何提前將給銀行的錢掉包並將假錢最終銷毀。 之後「四騎士」和亞瑟坐私人飛機前往新奧爾良準備第二場演出，艾爾瑪與迪倫跟隨其後，迪倫對利用別人缺點的魔術師很厭惡，但艾爾瑪認為魔術能給人快樂。到了現場，聯邦調查局布控監視，亞瑟警告賽迪斯不要阻礙「四騎士」的演出但不成功。艾爾瑪提起了一個著名魔術師萊諾·謝克是如何將卡片「變進」樹里，和其意外身亡的那次保險箱沉河逃脫表演中並沒有找到屍體。「四騎士」開始他們的第二場表演，在一系列前置表演後，「四騎士」挑選了一批觀眾，說道他們手上有一個信封，上面有張紙寫上了他們在銀行的存款金額，之後他們還邀請亞瑟來到舞台，同樣準備一張紙，寫上了他擁有的存款金額，在他們的表演下，亞瑟的金額在減少而觀眾的在增加，不久後觀眾的手機收到了銀行的存款變動信息，聯邦調查局也證實了資金變動，這時「四騎士」揭露了他們實際是亞瑟旗下的崔斯勒保險的客戶，由於一次災難中蒙受損失，但被崔斯勒保險剋扣了保險賠付，所以他們「替天行道」並且令亞瑟蒙羞（實際上在飛機上套取了亞瑟的安全問題信息而實施成功）。在聯邦調查局的圍捕下，「四騎士」還是逃過圍捕。惱羞成怒的亞瑟決定資助賽迪斯來幫手抓住「四騎士」。迪倫一時間懷疑艾爾瑪是內應，但冷靜下來後，聽了作為研究人員的艾爾瑪提到關於魔術師所信奉的「天眼」的傳說，也意外發現自己的手機被調包並知道他們去到了紐約。

TITLE: The Purge
PLOT SUMMARY: In 2014, following aneconomic collapsein theUnited States, a political party called the "New Founding Fathers of America" is voted into office. It creates an annual 12-hour "Purge," during which all crime using a "Class 4" weapon or lower is legal and emergency services are unavailable. By 2022, the economy is booming, with unemployment having fallen to 1% and crime to an all-time low. Many commentators attribute these successes to the Purge, although some note that the Purge mostly impacts the poor and marginalized. In 2022, security systems salesman James Sandin returns to his home in an affluentLos Angelesgated communityto wait out the Purge with his wife, Mary, and their two children, 15-year-old Zoey and 11-year-old Charlie. During a family dinner, James announces that he is now the top salesman in his company. He assures them that his company's upgraded security system, which he has also sold to multiple neighbors, will protect them during the Purge. As an extra precaution, James retrieves a pistol from agun safe. Charlie objects to the impending violence of the Purge, but James explains that it has rid the country of poverty and crime by giving people an outlet for their pent-up anger. Shortly before the Purge begins at 7 p.m., James enables the security system, which seals the doors and windows with metal plating. Returning to her room, Zoey is surprised by her older boyfriend Henry, who sneaked inside before James activated the security system. Henry tells Zoey that he has come to confront her father over his disapproval of their relationship. On the security monitors, Charlie sees a wounded stranger outside their home, desperately calling for help. He disables the security system to allow the man inside, but James re-engages the system and holds the man at gunpoint. Henry comes downstairs with a pistol and tries to shoot James, but James returns fire and mortally wounds Henry, who later dies on Zoey's bedroom floor. During the chaos, the stranger disappears.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 2022年的洛杉矶，杀戮日开始的两小时前，家用保全系统商人詹姆斯·桑丁在公司销售额居首而大获全胜后，开心地回到郊区家中豪宅里向妻子玛丽、女儿柔伊和儿子查理宣布这条好消息，用完晚餐后等待接下来的时刻。在杀戮日开始的一分钟前，詹姆斯野心勃勃地为家人展示自己引以为豪的堡垒型保全系统：利用几英尺高的淬火钢墙封住所有窗户和大门，认为足以能让他们今晚高枕无忧。随后，美国新闻开始播报固定预警系统，随着几声警报响起开始长达十二小时的街头血洗，桑丁一家决定用娱乐来打发接下来的几个小时。而柔伊回房间时发现她的男友亨利躲在里面，其希望能靠今晚向柔伊父亲詹姆斯证明自己能跟她交往，两人便背着家人躲在房间里约会。 不到几小时，电视直播到美国各地街道已战火连连、尸体遍布、血流成河，查理偷看家庭监视器注意到一名浑身淤血的陌生人来到他们家门口上求救，基于同情心而私自打开主门将他放进家里躲避。当詹姆斯与玛丽看到查理放进来的陌生人时，亨利到楼下掏出手枪打算杀死詹姆斯，以和柔伊双宿双飞，却先被有所防备的詹姆斯开两枪身亡。陌生人趁混乱跑进房子中失去踪影，迫使一家人分头寻找他。这时，十几名全副武装、面戴笑脸面具的青少年来到桑丁家豪宅前，其领袖靠桑丁一家门口摆放的支持杀戮日的蓝花盆，希望他们一家能和平地将陌生人交出来接受他们的制裁，顺势断掉豪宅的电力作为警告手段。恐慌之余，詹姆斯对家人坦白他的保全系统是外表看似坚固、并不是应对特殊紧急情况所设计的“装饰品”，如果按兵不动绝对会被一网打尽，因此决定找出陌生人来兑现外面敌人的要求。 除了詹姆斯与玛丽在黑暗豪宅里四处寻找时，查理不情愿交出他救的陌生人，而利用自己研制的具有视讯与闪光功能的机器人，将陌生人引导到自己的一个藏匿壁橱中。柔伊不慎找到他的躲藏地，因此被陌生人挟持为人质，詹姆斯将陌生人压制后将他拿胶带捆绑，甚至为了防止他乱动而用刀子折磨，所有人在无法接受这种残酷手段后远离他，霎那间领略到自己太过残酷后，詹姆斯决心抗击外面的敌人以捍卫家人。外面的青少年们通过几辆卡车和铁链拴住所有铁墙，在同一时间将所有的铁墙全部拉塌，集体跑进豪宅里中疯狂破坏。詹姆斯拿出家里收藏的散弹枪杀死几位敌人，青少年领袖突然出现一刀刺伤他。詹姆斯忍着疼痛爬到楼梯口遇到玛丽与查理，领袖也跟着他走到门口打算了结一家人，所幸柔伊将他开数枪射杀身亡而救下家人。

TITLE: Epic
PLOT SUMMARY: After her mother dies, 17-year-old Mary Katherine ("M.K.") moves in with her eccentricscientistfather Professor Bomba inDanbury, Connecticut. Bomba spent his life researching the Leafmen, tiny humanoid soldiers who protect the neighboring forest from wicked creatures called Boggans. M.K. is irritated by her father's work, believing his theories to be nonsense. Meanwhile, Nod, an independent yet rebellious young Leafman, decides to quit, much to the ire of his no-nonsense leader Ronin, who promised Nod's late father he would look out for him. The forest's benevolent ruler, Queen Tara, must choose her successor and arrives at a pool of lily pods, occupied by Mub, a laid-backslugand Grub, a wannabe Leafmansnail. Immediately after she chooses a pod, the Boggans attack and overwhelm the Leafmen, while Tara flees with Ronin on hishummingbirdmount. The pair are pursued by the Boggans' leader Mandrake and his son Dagda, who is killed by Ronin, but it allowed Mandrake to badly wound Tara with an arrow. M.K. decides to leave after getting into an argument with Bomba about his research. Outside, M.K. encounters the falling Tara, who entrusts the pod to her, shrinks her with magic, and tells her to take it to Nim Galuu, aglowwormwizard, before finally dying. M.K. is accompanied by Ronin, Mub, and Grub, while Ronin recruits a reluctant Nod after saving him from short-temperedtoadgangsterBufo.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 女孩MK（阿曼达·西耶弗里德配音）的科学家父亲常告诉她，世上存在着另一个精灵国度，有一群人一直在保护着绿色生态平衡，不要因为没看见，就认为他们不存在。当她无意中闯进森林遇见受难的森林皇后泰拉（碧昂丝·诺利斯配音），突然被交付一项重责大任—守护延续森林命脉的花苞。 当MK进入这个神秘的小宇宙，见到叛逆的树叶人纳德（乔什·哈切森配音）、会说话的毛毛虫尼姆（史蒂芬·泰勒配音）、保护森林的树叶人、蒲公英仙子、搞笑的蜗牛摩布与蛞蝓咕噜布，以及癞蛤蟆布孚（饶舌创作歌手皮普配音），这才发现父亲长久以来追寻的都是真实存在的。 眼看着大地之母将被以曼瑞克（克里斯托弗·瓦尔兹配音）为首的邪恶势力摧毁，MK为了保卫这个奇幻世界与自己的家园，必须运用智慧结合以罗尼为领袖的森林战士（科林·法瑞尔配音）与纳德的力量，以及他们各自拥有的可爱诙谐天性，才能化解危机。挺身而出的MK与这群有趣又勇敢的森林战士们，如何拯救世界幸免于难？
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 女孩MK（雅曼達·施菲配音）的科學家父親常告訴她，世上存在着另一個精靈國度，有一群人一直在保護着綠色生態平衡，不要因為沒看見，就認為他們不存在。當她無意中闖進森林遇見受難的森林皇后泰拉（碧昂絲·諾利斯配音），突然被交付一項重責大任—守護延續森林命脈的花苞。 當MK進入這個神秘的小宇宙，見到叛逆的樹葉人納德（祖舒·夏捷臣配音）、會說話的毛毛蟲尼姆（史蒂芬·泰勒配音）、保護森林的樹葉人、蒲公英仙子、搞笑的蝸牛摩布與蛞蝓咕嚕布，以及癩蛤蟆布孚（饒舌創作歌手Pitbull配音），這才發現父親長久以來追尋的都是真實存在的。 眼看着大地之母將被以曼瑞克（基斯托夫·華薩配音）為首的邪惡勢力摧毀，MK為了保衛這個奇幻世界與自己的家園，必須運用智慧結合以羅尼為領袖的綠國奇兵（哥連·費路配音）與納德的力量，以及他們各自擁有的可愛詼諧天性，才能化解危機。挺身而出的MK與這群有趣又勇敢的綠國奇兵們，如何拯救世界倖免於難？

TITLE: This Is the End
PLOT SUMMARY: Jay Baruchelarrives inLos Angelesto visit his old friendSeth Rogen, who invites him to ahousewarming partyhosted byJames Franco. There, Baruchel feels uncomfortable, so he and Rogen visit aconvenience store. When araptureoccurs, Rogen and Baruchel flee back to Franco's house and find the party unscathed. Anearthquakestrikes and the crowd rushes outside, witnessing asinkholeopening up in the yard. Several celebrities and partygoers are killed as Rogen, Baruchel, Franco,Jonah HillandCraig Robinsonrun back inside and discover on the news that the earthquake has destroyed most of the city. The remaining partygoers take inventory of their supplies, set up a ration system, board up the house and await help. Danny McBride, who crashed the party earlier, wakes up first the next morning and, unaware of the crisis, wastes much of the group's sustenance. He disbelieves what the others tell him of the previous night's events until a man outside gets decapitated by an unseen creature. Tensions rise due to various conflicts, including Baruchel and Rogen's growing estrangement and the others' skepticism of the former's belief that the disaster might be theApocalypsepredicted in theBook of Revelation.Emma Watsonmakes her way back to Franco's house, only to flee with the group's remaining drinks after misinterpreting an overheard conversation, believing they intend torapeher. Robinson tries to obtain water from Franco's cellar, only to find the doors locked. He then encounters another unseen creature, causing him to believe Baruchel's theory. Baruchel and Rogen dig through the floor and find the water, but McBride wastes most of it out of spite and the others kick him out of the house. Before leaving, McBride reveals that Baruchel was in town two months prior, but stayed at a hotel instead of with Rogen due to their strained friendship. That night, Hill prays for Baruchel to die and ispossessedby ademon. While Robinson and Baruchel head to a neighbor's house to scavenge for supplies, Rogen and Franco get attacked by the possessed Hill. The former two return and help subdue Hill, tying him to a bed. During anexorcismattempt, Baruchel and Rogen fight and knock over a candle, starting a fire that engulfs Hill and the house and forces the others outside.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 杰·巴鲁契来到洛杉矶拜访他同为演员的老朋友塞斯·罗根，罗根邀请巴鲁契一起参加詹姆斯·弗兰科的新居落成派对。在那里许多明星们群聚在一起饮酒、嗑药、做爱，享受喧闹的派对。派对上巴鲁契对于面对乔纳·希尔、克里斯·敏兹普雷斯（英语：Christopher Mintz-Plasse）、迈克尔·塞拉、克雷格·罗宾森和艾玛·沃特森等一群不熟识的朋友感到不舒服，因此罗根便陪着巴鲁契暂时离开到便利商店买烟。 在便利商店内，突然从外面的天空射入多道蓝色的光柱，并将多位顾客吸走。吓坏的罗根和巴鲁契急忙逃回弗兰科家中，在路上经历了一连串爆炸和车祸等混乱场面后，他们最后发现派对却毫不受到外面世界的影响。巴鲁契向大家描述外面的混乱状况，但却被当做玩笑嘲弄，此时一场地震让所有人都从房屋中逃了出去，这时他们发现整个好莱坞山丘（英语：Hollywood Hills）已经陷入一片火海。地表上突然出现一条大裂缝，塞拉、敏兹普雷斯、蕾哈娜、明蒂·卡琳（英语：Mindy Kaling）、马汀·史达、阿兹伊兹·安萨里（英语：Aziz Ansari）、凯文·哈特、杰森·席格尔和大卫·克伦荷茨等大多数人都掉进裂缝中丧生。罗根、巴鲁契、弗兰科、希尔和罗宾森逃过一劫存活了下来，并从新闻中得知这是加州历史上最大的一次地震。相信自己的知名度能够让救援队很快来到，同时他们开始清点屋内的补给品，包括食物、水、许多药品以及一把手枪。他们讨论出了一套配给的方式，并将门窗封住，在屋内等待救援。 隔天清晨，昨天潜入派对的丹尼·麦布理德在屋内第一个醒来，但其他人却完全不认识他。麦布理德起床后浪费了大多数仅存的食物帮所有人烹煮了早餐，对于外面发生的一切灾难毫无所知。起初他不相信一群人向他解释外面所发生的灾难，直到一个陌生人出现在门口寻求他们的帮助。这群幸存者在屋内开始嗑药来度过时间，并用家庭摄影机自制自演了2008年电影《菠萝快递》的续集。随着时间的经过，许多冲突开始让气氛陷入紧绷，罗根与巴鲁契之间的关系也开始失和，巴鲁契相信这场灾难可能是启示录中所描述的天启，但其他人对此感到怀疑。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 積·巴朗祖來到洛杉磯拜訪他同為演員的老朋友薛夫·洛根，羅根邀請巴朗祖一起參加占士·法蘭高的新居落成派對。在那裏許多明星們群聚在一起飲酒、嗑藥、做愛，享受喧鬧的派對。派對上巴朗祖對於面對祖納·希爾、克里斯·敏茲普雷斯（英語：Christopher Mintz-Plasse）、米高·施拿、克雷格·羅賓森和愛瑪·屈臣等一群不熟識的朋友感到不舒服，因此羅根便陪着巴朗祖暫時離開到便利商店買煙。 在便利商店內，突然從外面的天空射入多道藍色的光柱，並將多位顧客吸走。嚇壞的羅根和巴朗祖急忙逃回法蘭高家中，在路上經歷了一連串爆炸和車禍等混亂場面後，他們最後發現派對卻毫不受到外面世界的影響。巴朗祖向大家描述外面的混亂狀況，但卻被當做玩笑嘲弄，此時一場地震讓所有人都從房屋中逃了出去，這時他們發現整個荷里活山丘（英語：Hollywood Hills）已經陷入一片火海。地表上突然出現一條大裂縫，塞拉、敏茲普雷斯、Rihanna、明蒂·卡琳（英語：Mindy Kaling）、馬汀·史達、阿茲伊茲·安薩里（英語：Aziz Ansari）、奇雲·哈特、積遜·史格和大衛·古漢茲等大多數人都掉進裂縫中喪生。羅根、巴朗祖、法蘭高、希爾和羅賓森逃過一劫存活了下來，並從新聞中得知這是加州歷史上最大的一次地震。相信自己的知名度能夠讓救援隊很快來到，同時他們開始清點屋內的補給品，包括食物、水、許多藥品以及一把手槍。他們討論出了一套配給的方式，並將門窗封住，在屋內等待救援。 隔天清晨，昨天潛入派對的丹尼·麥布理德在屋內第一個醒來，但其他人卻完全不認識他。麥布理德起床後浪費了大多數僅存的食物幫所有人烹煮了早餐，對於外面發生的一切災難毫無所知。起初他不相信一群人向他解釋外面所發生的災難，直到一個陌生人出現在門口尋求他們的幫助。這群倖存者在屋內開始嗑藥來度過時間，並用家庭攝影機自製自演了2008年電影《菠蘿快遞》的續集。隨着時間的經過，許多衝突開始讓氣氛陷入緊繃，羅根與巴朗祖之間的關係也開始失和，巴朗祖相信這場災難可能是啟示錄中所描述的天啟，但其他人對此感到懷疑。

TITLE: World War Z
PLOT SUMMARY: FormerUnited Nationsinvestigator Gerald "Gerry" Lane, his wife, Karin, and their two daughters, Rachel and Connie, are caught in traffic in downtownPhiladelphiawhen azombieoutbreak hits. Escaping the ensuing chaos, they travel toNewarkand rescue Tommy, a young boy whose family hunkered down in their apartment and refused to leave. They are rescued by a helicopter sent by Thierry Umutoni, theUN deputy secretary-general. The group is then taken to aUS Navyvessel stationed in theAtlantic Ocean, where a team of scientists studies the outbreak. Among them isvirologistAndrew Fassbach, who believes that the plague is caused by avirusand that finding its origin is crucial for developing a vaccine. Faced with the threat of his family's eviction from the vessel, Gerry reluctantly agrees to assist Fassbach. Gerry, Fassbach, and aNavy SEALescort fly toCamp HumphreysinSouth Korea, from where the first report of zombies was received. Upon arrival, the group is attacked by zombies, causing a panicked Fassbach to slip on the plane ramp and accidentally shoot himself dead. The team is saved by US soldiers stationed at the camp, and Gerry discovers that the infection was brought to the base by its doctor. ACIAofficer imprisoned there guides Gerry towardsIsrael, where theMossadhas established a secure area.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 前联合国调查员杰瑞·蓝恩（Gerry Lane）带着妻子凯伦和两个女儿在费城市区公路上行车时，突然发生一系列事故。他们逃离城市，被一个墨裔家庭收留一晚。 等到凌晨时，墨裔家庭被僵尸袭击丧生，家中小男孩汤玛斯侥幸逃生后赶上杰瑞一家，最后和他们一起坐直升机逃离城市，到达位于大西洋的联合国航空母舰安格斯号。安顿好家人后，杰瑞在航母战情室与美军人员会谈后得知在韩国的美军基地曾发现病毒并有最早的报告。因此杰瑞在隔天跟随护卫队和一名哈佛学者法斯贝出发前往韩国调查病毒。 众人抵达韩国，但发现基地已经沦陷，在此期间哈佛学者法斯贝在躲避僵尸时不幸身亡，追查病毒的责任落在杰瑞身上，史匹克上尉率领的汉弗莱营驻军带领他们进入位于病毒爆发点的基地内部。杰瑞接替法斯贝独自调查，进入基地里最早爆发病毒的病房却没得出什么结论，因为病房因病毒失控爆发而被烧毁。于是他们决定去耶路撒冷寻找更多答案，因为以色列成功抵御了最初的爆发并提前建立了隔离设施。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 前聯合國調查員傑瑞·藍恩（Gerry Lane）帶着妻子凱倫和兩個女兒在費城市區公路上行車時，突然發生一系列事故。他們逃離城市，被一個墨裔家庭收留一晚。 等到凌晨時，墨裔家庭被喪屍襲擊喪生，家中小男孩湯瑪斯僥倖逃生後趕上傑瑞一家，最後和他們一起坐直升機逃離城市，到達位於大西洋的聯合國航空母艦安格斯號。安頓好家人後，傑瑞在航母戰情室與美軍人員會談後得知在韓國的美軍基地曾發現病毒並有最早的報告。因此傑瑞在隔天跟隨護衛隊和一名哈佛學者法斯貝出發前往韓國調查病毒。 衆人抵達韓國，但發現基地已經淪陷，在此期間哈佛學者法斯貝在躲避喪屍時不幸身亡，追查病毒的責任落在傑瑞身上，史匹克上尉率領的漢弗萊營駐軍帶領他們進入位於病毒爆發點的基地內部。傑瑞接替法斯貝獨自調查，進入基地裏最早爆發病毒的病房卻沒得出什麼結論，因為病房因病毒失控爆發而被燒毀。於是他們決定去耶路撒冷尋找更多答案，因為以色列成功抵禦了最初的爆發並提前建立了隔離設施。

TITLE: Red 2
PLOT SUMMARY: Three years after the events of the previous film, ex-CIA operative Frank Moses tries to lead a normal life with girlfriend Sarah Ross. He dismisses Marvin Boggs' claims that enemies are still after them; Marvin drives off and his car explodes. Although Frank is unconvinced Marvin is dead, Sarah convinces him to attend Marvin's funeral where he delivers a tearful eulogy. Government agents interrogate Frank at anFBIYankee Whitefacility. Corrupt agent Jack Horton and a team ofprivate military contractorsambush the facility; he threatens to torture Sarah until Frank gives him the information he needs. Frank evades Horton, and with the help of the still living Marvin, goes on the run with Sarah. Marvin explains he and Frank have been targeted as members of Operation Nightshade, a clandestine operation during theCold Warto smuggle a nuclear weapon intoRussia. They learned that  physicist Dr. Edward Bailey is the creator of the Nightshade bomb. Horton convinces international agencies that Frank and his associates are terrorists on the run. Frank's old ally Victoria notifies him that she has been contracted byMI6to kill the fugitives. Another top contract killer, Han Cho-Bai, is also hired, seeking revenge against Frank. Frank, Marvin, and Sarah steal Han's plane and fly toParisto find "The Frog", with the Americans and Han in pursuit. They are met by Katja Petrokovich, aRussian secret agentwith whom Frank had a relationship, who is also investigating Nightshade. They interrogate the Frog and Sarah, hoping to one-up Katja, seduces him.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 前中情局特工弗兰克（布鲁斯·威利斯饰）解决退休问题后，原以为可以和女友莎拉（玛莉-露易斯·帕克饰）重新享受和平退休生活，却与前同事马文(约翰·马尔科维奇饰)卷入核战风暴。原来传言有人将会把战时一件离奇消失的大杀伤力核武器重新启动，弗兰克和马文被牵涉其中，被国际刑警展开全球通缉，英国MI6更委派他们的前同行兼战友，也是退休特工的维多莉亚（海伦·米伦饰）展开追杀。二人不得不重出江湖，在七国混战的情况下还要应付弗兰克的火辣旧情人卡嘉（凯瑟琳·薜达-锺斯饰）、破案关键的炸弹科学家贝利博士（安东尼·霍普金斯饰）、和对弗兰克穷追不舍的世界头号职业杀手韩秋白（李炳宪饰）。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 前中情局特工法蘭（布斯·韋利士飾）解決退休問題後，原以為可以和女友莎拉（瑪莉-露易斯·帕克飾）重新享受和平退休生活，卻與前同事馬文(尊·麥高維治飾)捲入核戰風暴。原來傳言有人將會把戰時一件離奇消失的大殺傷力核武器重新啟動，法蘭和馬文被牽涉其中，被國際刑警展開全球通緝，英國MI6更委派他們的前同行兼戰友，也是退休特工的維多莉亞（海倫·美蘭飾）展開追殺。二人不得不重出江湖，在七國混戰的情況下還要應付法蘭的火辣舊情人卡嘉（嘉芙蓮·薜達-鍾斯飾）、破案關鍵的炸彈科學家貝利博士（安東尼·鶴健士飾）、和對法蘭窮追不捨的世界頭號職業殺手韓秋白（李炳憲飾）。

TITLE: 2 Guns
PLOT SUMMARY: Robert "Bobby" Trench and Michael "Stig" Stigman are two criminals working together. Unbeknownst to each other, Bobby is anundercoverDEASpecial Agentand Stig is an undercoverUS Navy SEALandPetty Officer 1st Classwith theUnited States NavyOffice of NavaI Intelligence. They meetdrug lordManny "Papi" Greco at his farm in Mexico, where Papi gives Bobby a packet of cash instead of the cocaine he requested. Upon their return to the U.S., Bobby reports to his superior, Special Agent Jessup, and fellow agent Deb Rees, that he did not get thecocainethey need to convict Papi. Afterwards, he privately tells Rees, his mistress, that he will help Stig rob $3 million from Papi's bank in Tres Cruces, Texas to prosecute Papi fortax evasion. Stig reports to his commanding officer,Lieutenant CommanderHarold Quince, who tells him to kill Bobby so they can use the money to fundcovert operations. Bobby and Stig rob the bank as planned and are surprised to find over $43 million in the vault, not $3 million.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 一名美国缉毒局探员和一位海军卧底上士在一次任务中不期而遇，两人都发现自己陷入深不可测的圈套，无奈之下只能联手以共同找出幕后真相。 Bobby和Stig一黑一白两人进路边小餐厅用餐，Bobby先绕进对面银行开启保险箱服务。两人一路绊嘴，看似一对活宝，Stig却以打火机引发火灾警报。在所有顾客都疏散出去后，又将打火机抛入无人照管的炉灶引发大火。两人在爆炸中离去。 Bobby带着Stig去一处农场去取他以假护照交易所得的毒品，接头人却已遭不测。幕后老板想用等额的现金打发他遭拒。两人离开后企图跨过美墨边境时被捕。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 一名美國緝毒局探員和一位海軍臥底上士在一次任務中不期而遇，兩人都發現自己陷入深不可測的圈套，無奈之下只能聯手以共同找出幕後真相。 Bobby和Stig一黑一白兩人進路邊小餐廳用餐，Bobby先繞進對面銀行開啟保險箱服務。兩人一路絆嘴，看似一對活寶，Stig卻以打火機引發火災警報。在所有顧客都疏散出去後，又將打火機拋入無人照管的爐灶引發大火。兩人在爆炸中離去。 Bobby帶着Stig去一處農場去取他以假護照交易所得的毒品，接頭人卻已遭不測。幕後老闆想用等額的現金打發他遭拒。兩人離開後企圖跨過美墨邊境時被捕。

TITLE: Blue Jasmine
PLOT SUMMARY: Jasmine Francis disembarks inSan Franciscoafter a flight fromNew York City. She takes a taxi to her sister Ginger's apartment, where Ginger is dismayed to learn that Jasmine traveled first class despite claiming to be broke. Jasmine has recently suffered anervous breakdownand, having incurred heavy debts, has been forced to seek refuge with her sister. A series of flashbacks reveals that Jasmine's husband, money manager Hal Francis, was arrested for defrauding his clients. Ginger and her husband, Augie, were among Hal's victims; he swindled them out of $200,000 in lottery winnings that Augie had wanted to start a business with, and their marriage fell apart. Hal dies by suicide in prison after being publicly disgraced. Jasmine's stepson Danny subsequently dropped out ofHarvardand severed all ties with Jasmine. Following Hal's death, Jasmine began drinking heavily and abusinganti-anxietymedication. She also developed a habit of talking to herself about her past. Ginger is now dating a mechanic called Chili, whom Jasmine detests for his working class job and coarse manners. Jasmine considers becoming aninterior designerbecause of her "great taste" and past experience in decorating her homes. She wants to take an online course as these are least expensive but having no computer skills, she decides to take a class in computers first. With no income, she grudgingly takes a job as a receptionist with a dentist, who harasses her withunwanted sexual advances. When he assaults her, she fights him off and quits.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 纽约贵妇茉莉和富商丈夫哈罗德的婚姻触礁，经济也遭遇危机，于是她决定搬到旧金山与在超市工作的妹妹金吉住在一起，茉莉和金吉皆为从小被领养的孩子，两人并无血缘关系。 哈罗德是一名从事金融投资领域的富有男人，茉莉放弃大学文凭与之结婚时，哈罗德已有过一段婚姻，且有一个在哈佛大学就读的儿子丹尼（阿尔登·埃伦瑞奇饰）。此时茉莉与丈夫过着穿金戴银、经常出入豪华场所的奢华上流生活。但茉莉发现原来哈罗德经常与其他女子有染，还爱上了一名10多岁的法国女孩。得知丈夫外遇的茉莉无法接受，向丈夫哈罗德质问后，两人发生激烈争吵，茉莉愤而向FBI举报，揭发哈罗德在金融领域的诈骗罪行。而就在哈罗德当街被捕后，其家产亦遭没收和拍卖，导致茉莉过着前所未有的贫穷生活，继子丹尼则因同学的异样眼光而选择退学并离家出走，哈罗德又在狱中自杀身亡。茉莉因为此番一连串的打击而经常出现自言自语的神经质半崩溃状态，于是，破产的茉莉前往旧金山投靠妹妹金吉。 金吉与前夫奥吉（Andrew Dice Clay 饰）育有两个孩子，奥吉因在哈罗德处投资受骗赔光积蓄而与老婆离婚。其后金吉与一位名叫车利（Bobby Cannavale 饰）的男子交往，茉莉对车利并无好感，认为金吉应该再找一个更好的对象以改变自己的人生。因生活所迫，没有大学学历又无一技之长的茉莉在牙医诊所里担任助理，并利用空闲时间上电脑课，打算将来通过网上学习做一名室内设计师，学习真正自食其力。没料到却因为受到雇主医生（Michael Stuhlbarg 饰）的性骚扰而选择辞职。

TITLE: Turbo
PLOT SUMMARY: In a suburbantomatogarden ofVan NuysinCalifornia,Theo, self-named "Turbo", is a garden snail who dreams of being a racer like his hero, five-timeIndy 500champion Guy Gagné. However, his obsession with racing makes him an outcast in the slow and cautious snail community, and a constant embarrassment to his older brother, Chet. One night, after nearly getting killed by alawnmowerwhile attempting to retrieve a fallen tomato that day, Theo wanders onto afreewayto admire the traffic and wishes to be fast. Suddenly, he gets sucked through thesuperchargerof aChevrolet Camaroduring adrag race, fusing his body withnitrous oxide. Upon waking up the next day, he gradually discovers he now possessessuper speedas well as other characteristics of a car, but his first attempt using his newfound speed ends with him accidentally crashing a boy's tricycle into his own garden crew's tomato garden, resulting in him and Chet getting fired. While chewing out Theo for his recklessness, Chet is snatched by a crow, but Theo rescues him near a rundownstrip mallcalled "Starlight Plaza". Both are then captured by Tito Lopez, ataco truckdriver who works at the Plaza and are brought to asnail raceheld by him and his co-workers. Theo wins the race in a matter of seconds, earning the respect of the snails led by Whiplash, and firmly establishing the name "Turbo" as his own, while Tito plans to revive Starlight Plaza with Turbo as a main attraction, but Tito's older brother Angelo furiously dismisses him. Turbo convinces Tito to enter him in the upcoming Indy 500 as a competitor, and after the snails divert and strand a tour bus to see Turbo's superspeed, bringing impressive business, Tito's co-workers agree to put up the entrance fee and accompany them toIndianapolis. At theIndianapolis Motor Speedway, Turbo gets to show off his speed after a chance meeting with Gagné, both qualifying for the race by achieving a speed of 226 mph and becoming a sensation on social media, and the CEO ofIndyCarreluctantly lets Turbo compete when Gagné supports him. The night before the race, Turbo sneaks out after a heated argument with Chet who is completely against the idea of his younger brother being in the race as he fears he might get hurt or killed by the other racers. Turbo encounters Gagné, who reveals he solely cares about winning and that he only supported Turbo's participation in the race so it would bring him more publicity, then demoralizes and warns Turbo to back out of the race while escorting him out of his pit garage.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 一只名叫特伯的蜗牛，一直梦想可以参加印第安纳波利斯500英里大赛。在一次被吸进汽车引擎的意外之后，车内的氮氧加速系统让它的DNA发生基因突变，让它化身成为一只有超能力，速度极高的蜗牛。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 一隻名叫Turbo的蝸牛，一直夢想可以參加印第安納波利斯500英里大賽。在一次被吸進汽車引擎的意外之後，車內的氮氧加速系統讓它的DNA發生基因突變，讓它化身成為一隻有超能力，速度極高的蝸牛。

TITLE: The Conjuring
PLOT SUMMARY: In 1968, renowneddemonologistsEd and Lorraine Warreninvestigate theAnnabellecase, in which friends Debbie and Camilla have apossesseddoll. They allowed a spirit, who claimed to be a seven-year-old girl named Annabelle Higgins, to possess the doll, and the hauntings became increasingly disturbing. The Warrens explain that the doll was never possessed; it was only a conduit for ademonicspirit whose goal was to possess one of the friends. Three years later, in 1971, Roger and Carolyn Perron move into a farmhouse inHarrisville, Rhode Island, with their five daughters: Andrea, Nancy, Christine, Cindy, and April. Their dog, Sadie, refuses to enter the house. The family discovers a boarded-up cellar in the house and paranormal events occur within the first few nights. Every clock in the house stops at 3:07 a.m. Carolyn awakens with new bruises each morning, and Sadie is found dead in the yard. Carolyn and Christine both encounter amalevolent spirit. Carolyn contacts the Warrens, who conduct an initial investigation, during which Lorraine, aclairvoyant, sees that a dark entity has latched on to the family so that even leaving the house will not free them. To gather evidence, they place cameras and bells around the house with the help of their assistant Drew Thomas and police officer Brad Hamilton. Research reveals that the house once belonged to an accusedwitchandSatanistnamed Bathsheba Sherman (a relative ofMary Towne Eastey), who sacrificed her week-old baby tothe deviland killed herself in 1863 at 3:07 in the morning after cursing all who take her land. There have since been reports of numerous murders and suicides through the years in the houses that were built on the land.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 1971年，美国罗德岛州哈维尔，罗杰和卡洛琳·佩伦夫妇陪五个女儿安卓莉亚、南希、克莉丝汀、辛蒂与爱普搬进一栋郊区大宅，但屋子里几天下来开始发生一连串诡异超自然现象：一家的宠物狗在搬进去的第二天就神秘死亡，家中所有钟全部停在凌晨三点零七分，腐烂尸臭充斥着整间屋子，一楼的门会自行频繁开关，卡洛琳身上频繁出现淤青，克莉丝汀睡觉时常觉得有人在抓她的脚，有梦游症的辛蒂睡着时会用头不停地撞击一个老橱柜，而爱普不停地在跟一名“想象朋友”罗伊说话。几天后的晚上，卡洛琳跟着一段拍手声吸引至堆满老旧物品的地下室后被反锁其中，当时在二楼的安卓莉亚与辛蒂也遭到一个不明恶灵攻击。当罗杰赶回家时，恶灵迹象消失地无影无踪，一家人由此确信这些现象绝非寻常。 卡洛琳为了寻求帮助而去听艾德与萝琳·华伦夫妇的魔鬼学讲座，得知他们夫妇曾处理过相似事件后，因此私下委托他们到她的家中看看。萝琳刚进屋就透过与生俱来的阴阳眼看到屋内徘徊著不祥事物，艾德将一家人表述所经历的事情录下后，决定为他们家进行驱魔仪式的前置工作，将捕捉到灵异现象后向天主教会报告，请求神父来执行驱魔。夫妇俩靠搜集的资料得知房子起初由商人杰德森·薛曼建于1863年，其妻贝斯希芭则身为出身于巫术世家的女子。贝斯希芭将她刚出世的孩子火祭，最后爬到房子码头边的树上，于凌晨三点零七分上吊自杀，以死诅咒所有“试图夺走她土地的人”。世纪以来，所有买下这栋房子包括周边土地的家庭几乎全部以不幸告终，大多是发生小孩失踪、灭门或是自杀案件，艾德和萝琳由此发现佩伦一家也同样受到诅咒。 华伦夫妇找来其助手德鲁和县警长布莱德，将房子的每个房间全部设置进行捕捉的照相机。但隔天下午，萝琳帮忙晒衣服时突然在二楼窗户上看见一个影子，当时在二楼房间午睡的卡洛琳也被一个女鬼魂袭击，而当萝琳赶到房间门口时，卡洛琳却平安无事走出来，声称她只是恶心呕吐。当晚，布莱德在厨房倒水时，在洗衣房撞见一个满手鲜血的女佣，而众人回头发现辛蒂再度开始梦游，走进老橱柜房间时门自动反锁，众人利用紫外线灯跟随脚印发现她睡在橱柜暗门后的墙隔间中；爱普称隔间是罗伊害怕其母亲发疯时的躲藏地。这时萝琳进入隔间查看却不慎踩空而跌进地下室，透过音乐盒的镜子中看见一个女人，发现她拿着带血菜刀、抱着自己孩子遗体发出哀嚎，始终哭喊着“这都是她逼我做的！”
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 1971年，美國羅德島州哈維爾，羅渣和卡洛琳·佩倫夫婦陪五個女兒安卓莉亞、南希、克莉絲汀、辛蒂與愛普搬進一棟郊區大宅，但屋子裏幾天下來開始發生一連串詭異超自然現象：一家的寵物狗在搬進去的第二天就神秘死亡，家中所有鐘全部停在淩晨三點零七分，腐爛屍臭充斥着整間屋子，一樓的門會自行頻繁開關，卡洛琳身上頻繁出現淤青，克莉絲汀睡覺時常覺得有人在抓她的腳，有夢遊症的辛蒂睡着時會用頭不停地撞擊一個老櫥櫃，而愛普不停地在跟一名「想像朋友」羅伊說話。幾天後的晚上，卡洛琳跟着一段拍手聲吸引至堆滿老舊物品的地下室後被反鎖其中，當時在二樓的安卓莉亞與辛蒂也遭到一個不明惡靈攻擊。當羅渣趕回家時，惡靈跡象消失地無影無蹤，一家人由此確信這些現象絕非尋常。 卡洛琳為了尋求幫助而去聽艾德與蘿琳·華倫夫婦的魔鬼學講座，得知他們夫婦曾處理過相似事件後，因此私下委託他們到她的家中看看。蘿琳剛進屋就透過與生俱來的陰陽眼看到屋內徘徊著不祥事物，艾德將一家人表述所經歷的事情錄下後，決定為他們家進行驅魔儀式的前置工作，將捕捉到靈異現象後向天主教會報告，請求神父來執行驅魔。夫婦倆靠搜集的資料得知房子起初由商人傑德森·薛曼建於1863年，其妻貝斯希芭則身為出身於巫術世家的女子。貝斯希芭將她剛出世的孩子火祭，最後爬到房子碼頭邊的樹上，於凌晨三點零七分上吊自殺，以死詛咒所有「試圖奪走她土地的人」。世紀以來，所有買下這棟房子包括周邊土地的家庭幾乎全部以不幸告終，大多是發生小孩失蹤、滅門或是自殺案件，艾德和蘿琳由此發現佩倫一家也同樣受到詛咒。 華倫夫婦找來其助手德魯和縣警長布萊德，將房子的每個房間全部設置進行捕捉的照相機。但隔天下午，蘿琳幫忙曬衣服時突然在二樓窗戶上看見一個影子，當時在二樓房間午睡的卡洛琳也被一個女鬼魂襲擊，而當蘿琳趕到房間門口時，卡洛琳卻平安無事走出來，聲稱她只是噁心嘔吐。當晚，布萊德在廚房倒水時，在洗衣房撞見一個滿手鮮血的女傭，而眾人回頭發現辛蒂再度開始夢遊，走進老櫥櫃房間時門自動反鎖，眾人利用紫外線燈跟隨腳印發現她睡在櫥櫃暗門後的牆隔間中；愛普稱隔間是羅伊害怕其母親發瘋時的躲藏地。這時蘿琳進入隔間查看卻不慎踩空而跌進地下室，透過音樂盒的鏡子中看見一個女人，發現她拿着帶血菜刀、抱着自己孩子遺體發出哀嚎，始終哭喊着「這都是她逼我做的！」

TITLE: Elysium
PLOT SUMMARY: In 2154,Earthis overpopulated, diseased, and heavily polluted fromecocide. The planet's citizens live in extreme poverty. In contrast, the rich and powerful live on Elysium, an orbitingspace stationjust outside Earth's atmosphere, with luxuries including Med-Bays, medical devices that can heal any disease or condition. Spider, a hacker living inLos Angeles, runs aspace shuttleoperation to smuggle people into Elysium. Elysium Defense Secretary Delacourt is in charge of preventing illegal entry to Elysium. She orders hired killer Kruger to shoot down Spider's space shuttles. Elysium President Patel reprimands Delacourt for her unorthodox methods, threatening to terminate her position for any more unauthorized actions. Patel then discharges Kruger. In retaliation, Delacourt offers Armadyne Corp CEO John Carlyle defense contracts for life if he creates a program allowing Delacourt to conduct acoupand install herself as president. Carlyle writes the program and stores it inside his brain. On Earth,paroleeMax Da Costa works for Armadyne Corp when he is accidentally exposed to a lethal dose ofradiation. He is only given medication for the side effects and told he has five days to live after being fired by Carlyle. Max and his friend Julio approach Spider to bargain: if Max successfully steals information from an Elysium citizen, Spider will give Max a shuttle ride to Elysium to use a Med-Bay to cure his condition. Max demands that the target be his former boss, Carlyle. Due to his declining health, Spider provides Max with a powerfulexoskeletonvia surgery.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 2154年，世界上最富有的权贵集体移居至生活设备齐全的人造宇宙都市“极乐世界”（Elysium）上，而其余平民继续生活在污染严重、疾病肆虐、犯罪盛行的地球，几乎无时不刻都面临着死亡威胁。极乐空间所装设著可治愈任何疾病、扭转衰老过程、还能细胞再生的“医疗床”（Med-Bay），让全地球平民对太空站望眼欲穿，数年下来靠非法移民的方式闯入太空站，短暂使用医疗床来为自己或孩子们治病。极乐空间国防部长洁西卡·德拉蔻为了保证太空站居民的生活水平，实行绝对隔离政策而严禁任何地球平民到太空站，而任何入侵太空站的平民全部会被她驱逐或枪决。 麦克斯·达科斯塔是一位孤儿出身的前偷车贼，居住在洛杉矶贫民窟度过假释期，并在全球榜首科技企业“阿玛达奈公司”（ArmadyneCorp）的机器人工厂打工。他有一天因闸门卡住而不慎困入机器人处理室并暴露在高度辐射之下，导致身体受辐射中毒影响而只剩五天性命，认为极乐空间的医疗床是唯一能救他的工具后，麦克斯跟好友胡里奥去见他的前雇主，负责极乐空间非法移民工作的人口走私客蜘蛛。麦克斯不怕死的决心受到蜘蛛赏识，因此拜托麦克斯帮他盗取与极乐空间具有关联的数据资料，同时命令部下通过手术，将一架机械外骨骼安装在麦克斯身上来助于他行动。 德拉蔻命令麾下潜伏特工克鲁格于地球击落两艘即将非法入侵太空站的太空舰艇、杀死大量平民，执法过当导致她受太空站总统帕特尔警告若再犯便革职。对官僚心生不满的德拉蔻秘密找来阿玛达奈公司执行长约翰·卡莱尔合作，协助她修改太空站主机内核、将她编码成新总统便会续签他的公司。卡莱尔回地球编写完重启程序后，将其保存在自己的大脑里作为保险措施，而他搭乘太空船飞往极乐空间过程中，麦克斯一行人将他的船击落至贫民窟里。在解决卡莱尔的机器护卫后，身负枪伤的卡莱尔濒临死亡，他们便趁卡莱尔死前将他脑里的重启程序直接同步复制到麦克斯的外骨骼脑神经主机内；内容因此被保护程序乱码化而无法阅读。对此紧张的德拉蔻被迫再次启用克鲁格，给他武器装备与战机而迅速赶到现场，当场杀害胡里奥与其他人，只有脑里保存着数据的麦克斯侥幸脱逃。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 2154年，世界上最富有的權貴集體移居至生活設備齊全的人造宇宙都市「極樂世界」（Elysium）上，而其餘平民繼續生活在污染嚴重、疾病肆虐、犯罪盛行的地球，幾乎無時不刻都面臨着死亡威脅。極樂帝國2154所裝設著可治癒任何疾病、扭轉衰老過程、還能細胞再生的「醫療床」（Med-Bay），讓全地球平民對太空站望眼欲穿，數年下來靠非法移民的方式闖入太空站，短暫使用醫療床來為自己或孩子們治病。極樂帝國2154國防部長潔西卡·德拉蔻為了保證太空站居民的生活水平，實行絕對隔離政策而嚴禁任何地球平民到太空站，而任何入侵太空站的平民全部會被她驅逐或槍決。 麥克斯·達科斯塔是一位孤兒出身的前偷車賊，居住在洛杉磯貧民窟度過假釋期，並在全球榜首科技企業「阿瑪達奈公司」（ArmadyneCorp）的機械人工廠打工。他有一天因閘門卡住而不慎困入機械人處理室並暴露在高度輻射之下，導致身體受輻射中毒影響而只剩五天性命，認為極樂帝國2154的醫療床是唯一能救他的工具後，麥克斯跟好友胡里奧去見他的前僱主，負責極樂帝國2154非法移民工作的人口走私客蜘蛛。麥克斯不怕死的決心受到蜘蛛賞識，因此拜託麥克斯幫他盜取與極樂帝國2154具有關聯的數據資料，同時命令部下通過手術，將一架機械外骨骼安裝在麥克斯身上來助於他行動。 德拉蔻命令麾下潛伏特工克魯格於地球擊落兩艘即將非法入侵太空站的太空艦艇、殺死大量平民，執法過當導致她受太空站總統帕特爾警告若再犯便革職。對官僚心生不滿的德拉蔻秘密找來阿瑪達奈公司執行長約翰·卡萊爾合作，協助她修改太空站主機內核、將她編碼成新總統便會續簽他的公司。卡萊爾回地球編寫完重啟程序後，將其保存在自己的大腦裏作為保險措施，而他搭乘太空船飛往極樂帝國2154過程中，麥克斯一行人將他的船擊落至貧民窟裏。在解決卡萊爾的機器護衛後，身負槍傷的卡萊爾瀕臨死亡，他們便趁卡萊爾死前將他腦裏的重啟程序直接同步複製到麥克斯的外骨骼腦神經主機內；內容因此被保護程序亂碼化而無法閱讀。對此緊張的德拉蔻被迫再次啟用克魯格，給他武器裝備與戰機而迅速趕到現場，當場殺害胡里奧與其他人，只有腦裏保存着數據的麥克斯僥倖脫逃。

TITLE: We're the Millers
PLOT SUMMARY: InDenver, low-level marijuana dealer David Clark is robbed of his money and stash, some of which he owes to his supplier and college acquaintance Brad Gurdlinger. Gurdlinger forces him to smuggle marijuana from Mexico to clear his debt. Realizing that attempting to get through customs alone would be suspicious, David hires his neighbors—a stripper stage-named Rose; local runaway Casey; and naïve, recently abandoned teenager Kenny—to pose as his wife, daughter, and son respectively, dubbing themselves the "Millers". When the Millers reach the compound, they learn it is not "a smidge" as Gurdlinger described, but two tons. They are stopped by authorities twice, but get by on bribery and sheer luck. Due to the extra load from the marijuana on the RV, one of the radiator hoses breaks. The Fitzgeralds (consisting of father Don, mother Edie, and daughter Melissa), a family actually vacationing in an RV whom the Millers had encountered at the border, catch up to them and tow them to a repair shop. On the way, they learn that Don is aDEAagent, alarming them. Kenny develops a crush on Melissa. After he reveals that he has never kissed a girl, Casey and Rose give him kissing lessons while David films; Melissa walks in on them and assumes they are in anincestuousrelationship.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 故事叙述不起眼的毒贩大卫在一次多管闲事下遭到小混混抢劫身上所拥有的2万元现金和大麻，因此欠下毒枭头目布拉德4万元的债务，为了还债他被迫要从事一次从墨西哥偷运大麻至美国的走私行动。为了安全起见，他特别雇来三人来扮演自己的家庭成员——从事脱衣舞的邻居萨拉扮妻子、逃家的太妹凯西和憨厚处男肯尼扮姐弟俩，并以房车旅行做掩护。“米勒一家”到墨西哥后，大卫的车里却装进了2吨重的大麻，原来大卫上了布拉德的当，将墨西哥毒枭帕布罗的货物给吞了。在返回丹佛途中，米勒一家认识了开着另一房车旅游的菲茨杰拉德一家，车主唐在缉毒署工作，两家在此过程中发生了许多啼笑皆非的事情，而“米勒之子”肯尼也与唐之女梅丽莎产生了感情。 后来帕布罗带人开车追击大卫以夺回毒品。大卫幸好得到唐的帮助一起抓获了帕布罗。而最终大卫决定为缉毒署效力，将毒枭布拉德抓获，米勒一家也因此作为控告布拉德的保护证人被警方给保护起来。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 故事敘述不起眼的毒販大衛在一次多管閒事下遭到小混混搶劫身上所擁有的2萬元現金和大麻，因此欠下毒梟頭目布拉德4萬元的債務，為了還債他被迫要從事一次從墨西哥偷運大麻至美國的走私行動。為了安全起見，他特別雇來三人來扮演自己的家庭成員——從事脫衣舞的鄰居薩拉扮妻子、逃家的太妹凱西和憨厚處男肯尼扮姐弟倆，並以房車旅行做掩護。「米勒一家」到墨西哥後，大衛的車裏卻裝進了2噸重的大麻，原來大衛上了布拉德的當，將墨西哥毒梟帕布羅的貨物給吞了。在返回丹佛途中，米勒一家認識了開着另一房車旅遊的菲茨傑拉德一家，車主唐在緝毒署工作，兩家在此過程中發生了許多啼笑皆非的事情，而「米勒之子」肯尼也與唐之女梅麗莎產生了感情。 後來帕布羅帶人開車追擊大衛以奪回毒品。大衛幸好得到唐的幫助一起抓獲了帕布羅。而最終大衛決定為緝毒署效力，將毒梟布拉德抓獲，米勒一家也因此作為控告布拉德的保護證人被警方給保護起來。

TITLE: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
PLOT SUMMARY: Following the FLDSMDFR incident in Swallow Falls,[b]Chester V, the CEO of Live Corp and Flint Lockwood's childhood idol, offers his company's services to help clean up the island, while temporarily relocating the town's populace to San Franjose, California. Chester hires Flint to work at Live Corp and he strives to receive a promotion, but inadvertently publicly humiliates himself six months later when his "Celebrationator" invention goes off as the promotion is being given to another employee. Chester later informs Flint that the seemingly-destroyed FLDSMDFR is still functioning and creating sentient food creatures known as "Foodimals", one of which attacked his employees stationed on Swallow Falls. Chester tells Flint that he needs to personally travel to the island, find the FLDSMDFR and insert aUSB flash drive-like device known as the "BS-USB" to shut it down. Flint takes his pet monkey Steve, his meteorologist girlfriend Sam Sparks, her cameraman Manny, police officer Earl Devereaux and former Swallow Falls mascot "Chicken" Brent McHale. Flint also reluctantly accepts the help of his widowed father Tim, who takes them to the island using his fishing boat. When Chester learns that Flint is not alone, he and his much-abusedorangutanassistant Barb gather some of their employees and follow. While Tim stays on the boat and befriends some livingpickles, Flint and his friends work their way through the jungle-like environment of food that now completely covers the island. They encounter many foodimals, including a livingstrawberrySam dubs "Barry". A Cheespider, the foodimal that attacked Chester's employees, chases the group before Chester arrives, scaring it off and joining the mission. Sam becomes suspicious of Chester's motives, as his claims about the foodimals being dangerous do not align with her observations. Flint is too afraid of failure to listen, eventually leading Sam and the others to go off on their own. They re-encounter and befriend the Cheespider, discovering that it was only acting hostile towards people wearing Live Corp gear. When the group deduces that the foodimals have realized something sinister about the company, as the "live" part of its name is simply "evil" spelled backwards, they attempt to warn Flint, but are captured by Chester's employees.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 上集讲到福林发明了一部可以将水转化为食物的“食物复制机”，点知搞到满城“汉堡雨”，更卷起“意大利粉龙卷风”！不过最后战胜食物复制机，而福林小时候崇拜的“点子博士”和他的企业跳出来收拾残局，可是原来“食物复制机”一直未停止运作，今次更变本加厉造出无数食物动物混合体“美食兽”，威胁人类命运！福林与朋友们于是再接受“美食”任务，誓要收拾“脆饼鳄”、“King Kong虾”及其它“美食兽”，但在背后协助的点子企业，却启动了它们的邪恶计划.......。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 上集講到福林發明了一部可以將水轉化為食物的「食物複製機」，點知搞到滿城「漢堡雨」，更捲起「意大利粉龍捲風」！不過最後戰勝食物複製機，而福林小時候崇拜的「點子博士」和他的企業跳出來收拾殘局，可是原來「食物複製機」一直未停止運作，今次更變本加厲造出無數食物動物混合體「美食獸」，威脅人類命運！福林與朋友們於是再接受「美食」任務，誓要收拾「脆餅鱷」、「King Kong蝦」及其它「美食獸」，但在背後協助的點子企業，卻啟動了它們的邪惡計劃.......。

TITLE: Captain Phillips
PLOT SUMMARY: Richard Phillipstakes command ofMVMaersk Alabama, an unarmedcontainer vesselfrom thePort of SalalahinOman, with orders to sail through theGuardafui ChanneltoMombasa, Kenya. Wary of pirate activity off the coast of theHorn of Africa, he and First OfficerShane Murphyorder strict security precautions on the vessel and carry out a practice drill. During the drill, the captain notices that the vessel is being followed by Somali pirates in twoskiffs, and calls for help. Knowing that the pirates are listening to radio traffic, he pretends to call a warship, requesting immediate air support. One skiff turns around in response, and the other – crewed by four armed pirates led byAbduwali Muse– loses engine power trying to steer throughMaersk Alabama's wake. The next day, Muse's skiff, now fitted with two outboard engines, returns with the same four pirates aboard. Despite the efforts of Phillips and his crew, the pirates secure their ladder to the ship. As they board, Phillips tells the crew to hide in the engine room, just before the pirates storm the bridge and hold Phillips and the other crew members at gunpoint. Phillips offers Muse the $30,000 in the ship's safe, but Muse's orders are to ransom the ship and crew in exchange for millions of dollars of insurance money from the shipping company. While they search the ship, Shane sees that the youngest pirate Bilal does not have sandals and tells the crew to line the engine room hallway with broken glass. Chief Engineer Mike Perry deactivates the power to the ship, plunging the lower decks into darkness. Bilal cuts his feet when they reach the engine room, and Muse continues to search alone. The crew members ambush Muse, holding him at knifepoint, and arrange to release him and the other pirates into alifeboat. However, Muse's right-hand man Nour Najee refuses to board the lifeboat with Muse unless Phillips goes with them. Once all are on the lifeboat, Najee attacks Phillips, forcing him into the vessel before launching the boat with all five of them on board.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 理查德·菲利普斯（汤姆·汉克斯饰）是阿曼塞拉莱港口的一艘大型货船——快桅阿拉巴马号的船长，这次他带领手下从阿曼向肯尼亚运送一批货物和援助物资。行驶至索马里海域附近的公海时，两艘海盗小快艇驶向了它，上面各载有携带着枪支的四名索马里海盗。一开始菲利普斯用计吓唬走了一艘，而另外一艘由Muse率领的快艇则紧追不舍，并最终强行登了上去。由于早有准备，菲利普斯在被俘前让大批船员躲避进了引擎舱里，后来Muse在搜找船员时被俘，而后双方协议交换船长并让这四名海盗带着三万美元现金离开，而就在海盗乘坐阿拉巴马号救生艇离开时菲利普斯再次遭到绑架，海盗计划将他带回索马里以让迫使货船公司交付巨额赎金。之后阿拉巴马号的船员向附近的一艘美国海军驱逐舰——班布里奇号求救，该舰舰长想通过谈判方式救回菲利普斯，与此同时，美国本土出发的海豹部队也前来参与拯救行动。最终Muse被骗上驱逐舰被俘，其他三名海盗在救生舱里被海豹队员击毙，而菲利普斯则获救。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 理查德·菲利普斯（湯·漢斯飾）是阿曼塞拉萊港口的一艘大型貨船——快桅阿拉巴馬號的船長，這次他帶領手下從阿曼向肯雅運送一批貨物和援助物資。行駛至索馬里海域附近的公海時，兩艘海盜小快艇駛向了它，上面各載有攜帶着槍支的四名索馬里海盜。一開始菲利普斯用計嚇唬走了一艘，而另外一艘由Muse率領的快艇則緊追不捨，並最終強行登了上去。由於早有準備，菲利普斯在被俘前讓大批船員躲避進了引擎艙里，後來Muse在搜找船員時被俘，而後雙方協議交換船長並讓這四名海盜帶着三萬美元現金離開，而就在海盜乘坐阿拉巴馬號救生艇離開時菲利普斯再次遭到綁架，海盜計劃將他帶回索馬里以讓迫使貨船公司交付巨額贖金。之後阿拉巴馬號的船員向附近的一艘美國海軍驅逐艦——班布里奇號求救，該艦艦長想通過談判方式救回菲利普斯，與此同時，美國本土出發的海豹部隊也前來參與拯救行動。最終Muse被騙上驅逐艦被俘，其他三名海盜在救生艙里被海豹隊員擊斃，而菲利普斯則獲救。

TITLE: Riddick
PLOT SUMMARY: Five years after Kyra's death,[a]Riddick has become uneasy in his role as Lord Marshal of the Necromonger fleet. His refusal to swear into the Necromonger faith has caused dissent among his subjects. After the latest attempt on his life, Riddick strikes a deal with Commander Vaako: the location of Furya and a ship to take him there, in exchange for Vaako succeeding him as the next Lord Marshal so that he can achievetranscendence. Led by Vaako's aide, Krone, Riddick and a group of Necromongers arrive on a desolate planet. Realizing that it is not Furya, Riddick kills most of his escorts when they attempt to assassinate him; Krone causes alandslideand buries Riddick alive. Riddick emerges from the rubble with a broken leg, which he sets and splints while fending off native predators:vulture-like flying animals, packs ofjackal-like beasts, and giant venomousscorpion-like water-dwelling Mud Demons. Needing time to heal, Riddick hides himself within some abandoned ruins. After he's fully healed, Riddick notices a vastsavannabeyond some rocky cliffs, but the only passage through is impeded by several muddy pools infested with Mud Demons. He begins injecting himself with Mud Demonvenomto build animmunityand constructs improvised melee weapons, as well as raising and training an orphaned jackal-beast pup. He kills the Mud Demons blocking his entrance and reaches the savanna. After finding a mercenary station, Riddick notices a series of approaching storms and concludes they will unleash a dangerous threat. Riddick activates an emergency beacon at the station, which broadcasts his identity to mercenary groups within the area. Two ships arrive in answer to the beacon; the first led by violent and unstable Santana, with second-in-command Diaz, preacher Luna, and hunters Falco, Rubio, Vargas, and Nuñez; the second led by Colonel R. "Boss" Johns, second-in-command and marksman Dahl, tracker Lockspur and gunner Moss. Riddick leaves them a message promising they will all die unless they leave one of their ships and depart the planet on the other. Rubio, Nuñez, and Falco are killed by Riddick during the first night, forcing a reluctant Santana to cooperate with Johns's team. Riddick later stealspower nodesfrom each of the teams' ships and approaches Johns and Santana to strike a deal for their return. However, the conversation turns into an ambush as Dahl shoots Riddick with several rounds of horse tranquilizer, and Riddick's jackal-beast is shot and killed by Santana.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 恶名昭彰的雷迪克（范·迪塞尔 饰）被同伴背叛后，独自被放逐到银河系上一个只有焦黑土壤的死亡星球，但很快的，前所未见的惊人变种怪物找上了他，在面临这群比起之前所有敌人都还可怕的嗜血怪物的情况下，为了生存，他迫不得已只能选择启动一个装置，而这也将引来所有为了得到重赏而一直追杀他的星际佣兵。尔后，雷迪克就开始了一场又一场的势死之战，与赏金猎人展开对决。 就在启动装置后，很快地讯号就引来了一批接着一批残酷无情且暴力无比的佣兵杀手，不仅如此，昔日和雷迪克有着数不清旧账的敌人也磨刀霍霍而来。就在一场将摧毁所有人的致命风暴即将来临之前，雷迪克必须打败所有为他人头而来的星际佣兵们，才有生存下来的一丝希望。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 惡名昭彰的雷迪克（雲·迪素 飾）被同伴背叛後，獨自被放逐到銀河系上一個只有焦黑土壤的死亡星球，但很快的，前所未見的驚人變種怪物找上了他，在面臨這群比起之前所有敵人都還可怕的嗜血怪物的情況下，為了生存，他迫不得已只能選擇啟動一個裝置，而這也將引來所有為了得到重賞而一直追殺他的星際傭兵。爾後，雷迪克就開始了一場又一場的勢死之戰，與賞金獵人展開對決。 就在啟動裝置後，很快地訊號就引來了一批接着一批殘酷無情且暴力無比的傭兵殺手，不僅如此，昔日和雷迪克有着數不清舊帳的敵人也磨刀霍霍而來。就在一場將摧毀所有人的致命風暴即將來臨之前，雷迪克必須打敗所有為他人頭而來的星際傭兵們，才有生存下來的一絲希望。

TITLE: The Counselor
PLOT SUMMARY: In Mexico, cocaine is packaged in barrels, concealed in a sewage truck, and driven across the border to the United States where it is stored at a sewage treatment plant. A lawyer from Texas who is known only as the Counselor goes to Amsterdam to meet with a diamond dealer to purchase an engagement ring for his girlfriend, Laura. Returning to the United States, the Counselor attends a party in Texas thrown by drug dealer Reiner and his girlfriend Malkina. He discusses an upcoming drug deal he is going in on with Reiner, which would be the Counselor's first. Their discussion ends with Reiner describing a device called "thebolito" which after being pulled around one's neck, self-constricts and decapitates the victim. Afterwards, at a dinner with Laura, the Counselor proposes marriage and she accepts. The Counselor meets with Westray, a business associate of Reiner's, to deliver his investment for the drug deal. Westray informs the Counselor of the deal's 4000% return rate, but cautions the Counselor about becoming involved, saying that Mexican cartels are merciless. Despite this, the Counselor remains outwardly confident and unconcerned. Following the conversation with Westray, the Counselor visits a prison inmate named Ruth, a court-appointed client of his who is on trial for murder. Ruth explains that her son is a biker, recently arrested for speeding, and cannot post bail. She asks the Counselor for help and he agrees to bail Ruth's son out as a favor.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 一位刚与女友萝拉（佩内洛普·克鲁兹饰演）订婚的律师（迈克尔·法斯宾德饰演）因为陷入财务危机不惜铤而走险，决定与他的客户—夜店老板雷纳（哈维尔·巴登饰演）跟墨西哥的毒枭进行毒品交易。尽管接收到许多关于这笔交易的潜在危机警告，但自大傲慢的性格却让他以为自己有能力全身而退。想不到一次交易失手，让他们都成为黑道追杀的对象。在这一场失控的巨大危机中，他要如何做出最正确的决定，拯救自己的人生。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 一位剛與女友蘿拉（彭妮露·古絲飾演）訂婚的律師（米高·法斯賓達飾演）因為陷入財務危機不惜鋌而走險，決定與他的客戶—夜店老闆雷納（查維爾·巴頓飾演）跟墨西哥的毒梟進行毒品交易。儘管接收到許多關於這筆交易的潛在危機警告，但自大傲慢的性格卻讓他以為自己有能力全身而退。想不到一次交易失手，讓他們都成為黑道追殺的對象。在這一場失控的巨大危機中，他要如何做出最正確的決定，拯救自己的人生。

TITLE: About Time
PLOT SUMMARY: Tim Lake grows up inCornwallwith his father James, mother Mary, uncle Desmond, and younger sister Katherine ("Kit Kat"). The morning after a less-than-great New Year’s Eve party, James tells Tim that the men of their family can travel back in time to moments they have lived before. Tim tests this by going back to the previous night’s party and changing a few events. When he returns, James discourages him from using his gift to acquire money or fame, and Tim decides to use it to improve his love life. The following summer, Kit Kat's friend Charlotte visits. Although instantly smitten, Tim waits until the last day to tell her; she tells him he should have told her earlier. Tim travels back in time to tell Charlotte in the middle of the holiday, but she suggests he wait until her last day. Heartbroken, he realises that she is uninterested in him and time travel cannot change anyone's mind. Tim moves to London to pursue a career as a lawyer, initially living with his father's acquaintance Harry, a playwright. He visits aDans le Noirrestaurant, where he meets Mary, an American who works for a publisher. They flirt in the darkness, and she gives Tim her phone number. He returns home to a distraught Harry, whose play's opening night has been ruined by an actor forgetting his lines. Tim goes back in time to help the actor so the play is a triumph.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 蒂姆·雷克在英国康瓦尔郡长大，和父亲詹姆斯、母亲玛丽、总是心不在焉的舅舅戴斯蒙、自由奔放的妹妹凯瑟琳（小凯）住在靠海的房子。在蒂姆21岁生日那天，他从父亲那里得知他家族的男人都有不为人知的特殊能力，此能力可以让使用者回到曾生活过的某个时刻。蒂姆验证了这项能力，詹姆斯不建议他用这项能力获得金钱或名声，所以蒂姆决定用这项能力来找女友。 次年夏天，小凯的朋友夏洛特来访，待了两个月。蒂姆被迷得神魂颠倒，但一直等到她要离开了才向她表示心意，夏洛特告诉蒂姆说他该早点告诉她。蒂姆回到一个月前并向夏洛特告白，但夏洛特建议他该等到最后一天。蒂姆意识到夏洛特其实对自己没有意思，而时间旅行的能力也不能改变他人的自由意志。 蒂姆试图成为律师，并搬去伦敦和父亲的朋友哈利同住，哈利是厌世的剧作家。六个月过去了，蒂姆在“Dans le Noir”餐厅和玛丽邂逅，两人在黑暗中调情，之后玛丽给了蒂姆她的电话号码，蒂姆回到家后发现哈利的心情很糟，原来哈利推出的新剧在首演时被忘词的主演给毁了。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 阿添·雷克在英國康瓦爾郡長大，和父親占士、母親瑪莉、總是心不在焉的舅舅戴斯蒙、自由奔放的妹妹凱瑟琳（小凱）住在靠海的房子。在阿添21歲生日那天，他從父親那裏得知他家族的男人都有不為人知的特殊能力，此能力可以讓使用者回到曾生活過的某個時刻。阿添驗證了這項能力，占士不建議他用這項能力獲得金錢或名聲，所以阿添決定用這項能力來找女友。 次年夏天，小凱的朋友夏洛蒂來訪，待了兩個月。阿添被迷得神魂顛倒，但一直等到她要離開了才向她表示心意，夏洛蒂告訴阿添說他該早點告訴她。阿添回到一個月前並向夏洛蒂告白，但夏洛蒂建議他該等到最後一天。阿添意識到夏洛蒂其實對自己沒有意思，而時間旅行的能力也不能改變他人的自由意志。 阿添試圖成為律師，並搬去倫敦和父親的朋友哈利同住，哈利是厭世的劇作家。六個月過去了，阿添在「Dans le Noir」餐廳和瑪莉邂逅，兩人在黑暗中調情，之後瑪莉給了阿添她的電話號碼，阿添回到家後發現哈利的心情很糟，原來哈利推出的新劇在首演時被忘詞的主演給毀了。

TITLE: Escape Plan
PLOT SUMMARY: FormerprosecutorRay Breslin is the founder and co-owner of Breslin-Clark, a security firm specializing in testing the security measures ofsupermax prisons. Posing as an inmate to study facilities from within and exploit their weaknesses to escape, Breslin is driven by the murders of his wife and child by an escaped convict he had successfully prosecuted, and has garnered a reputation as the man who canescape any prison. Breslin and his business partner, Lester Clark, receive a multimillion-dollar deal fromCIAoperative Jessica Miller to test a new,top secretprison fordisappeared personson the condition that Ray and his team cannot know the prison's true location. Although this violates his principles, Breslin agrees. InNew Orleans, Breslin allows himself to be captured under the alias Anthony Portos, aterrorist-for-hire, unfortunately, the plan goes awry when his captors remove a tracking microchip he had implanted in his arm and drug him, preventing his colleagues from knowing where he has been taken. During the flight, he witnesses a mercenary named Drake kill another captive. Breslin wakes up inside the prison and realizes that thewarden, Willard Hobbes, is not the same warden who was supposed to release him in an emergency and his evacuation code was useless. He discovers that the guards are clad in black masks and attire and the prison cells tend to rotate to various blocks. He befriends another inmate, Emil Rottmayer, who claims to be a security expert for Victor Mannheim, a facelessRobin Hood-type figure who steals from the wealthy.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 雷·布雷斯林是前检察官，现拥有着一间洛杉矶保安系统公司布雷斯林-克拉克（Breslin-Clark），该公司专门测试超高度安全级别（英语：Supermax prison）监狱的可靠性。布雷斯林花费了一生的时间进入监狱，研究他们的设计和守卫的习性以寻找和利用他们的弱点，来使自己能顺利逃狱。他的目标是能消除每所监狱的弱点而确保入狱的罪犯留在当中；原因在于过去，布雷斯林的妻小遭到了被他成功起诉的逃犯所杀害。 布雷斯林在成功逃出一所监狱后，和他的商业伙伴莱斯特·克拉克马上收到了中央情报局（CIA）探员洁西卡·麦尔所提出的一项价值数百万美元的交易，将以强迫失踪的方式将布雷斯林送入狱，用于测试一所绝密监狱中是否有使人逃脱的漏洞。但这一次，因有助于在逃脱时将外部帮助的风险降至最低，布雷斯林和他的同事不能知道监狱的位置。布雷斯林最后同意该协议，并以西班牙恐怖分子“安东尼·波多”的身份允许自己在路易斯安那州新奥尔良被捕。但当绑走自己的人从他的胳膊上取出追踪芯片并给他服用昏迷药物后，这阻止了布雷斯林的同事知晓他的所在处。 布雷斯林在一间没有外窗的玻璃牢房中醒来，并意识到典狱长不是他应该会见的那个人。之后，他遇见了狱友埃米尔·罗特梅尔，对方自称认识一名被称作现代罗宾汉的男子“维克多·默罕”。当布雷斯林取得罗特梅尔的信任后，自称能使他们逃出这里，而开始对单独禁闭室进行研究，该室使用高倍率卤素灯对囚犯造成晕眩和脱水。当发现该禁闭室地板的铆钉是由钢铁制成而非防潮铝时，罗特梅尔在布雷斯林的要求下从典狱长威拉·哈柏的办公楼偷拿到一枚金属片，之后两人和穆斯林囚犯贾维德再次被关进禁闭室。布雷斯林使用金属板将灯光聚焦至铆钉周围的钢材，当钢材膨胀时使铆钉弹开，使布雷斯林得以打开地板进入下方的通道。他发现该监狱是在一艘行驶于海洋中央的大型货船内部，要像以往的越狱完全不可能。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 雷·保龍是前檢察官，現擁有着一間洛杉磯保安系統公司保龍-克拉克（Breslin-Clark），該公司專門測試超高度安全級別（英語：Supermax prison）監獄的可靠性。保龍花費了一生的時間進入監獄，研究他們的設計和守衛的習性以尋找和利用他們的弱點，來使自己能順利逃獄。他的目標是能消除每所監獄的弱點而確保入獄的罪犯留在當中；原因在於過去，保龍的妻小遭到了被他成功起訴的逃犯所殺害。 保龍在成功逃出一所監獄後，和他的商業夥伴萊斯特·克拉克馬上收到了中央情報局（CIA）探員潔西卡·麥爾所提出的一項價值數百萬美元的交易，將以強迫失蹤的方式將保龍送入獄，用於測試一所絕密監獄中是否有使人逃脫的漏洞。但這一次，因有助於在逃脫時將外部幫助的風險降至最低，保龍和他的同事不能知道監獄的位置。保龍最後同意該協議，並以西班牙恐怖分子「安東尼·波多」的身份允許自己在路易斯安那州新奧爾良被捕。但當綁走自己的人從他的胳膊上取出追蹤晶片並給他服用昏迷藥物後，這阻止了保龍的同事知曉他的所在處。 保龍在一間沒有外窗的玻璃牢房中醒來，並意識到典獄長不是他應該會見的那個人。之後，他遇見了獄友伊曼·諾文，對方自稱認識一名被稱作現代羅賓漢的男子「維克多·默罕」。當保龍取得諾文的信任後，自稱能使他們逃出這裏，而開始對單獨禁閉室進行研究，該室使用高倍率鹵素燈對囚犯造成暈眩和脫水。當發現該禁閉室地板的鉚釘是由鋼鐵製成而非防潮鋁時，諾文在保龍的要求下從典獄長威拉·哈柏的辦公樓偷拿到一枚金屬片，之後兩人和穆斯林囚犯賈維德再次被關進禁閉室。保龍使用金屬板將燈光聚焦至鉚釘周圍的鋼材，當鋼材膨脹時使鉚釘彈開，使保龍得以打開地板進入下方的通道。他發現該監獄是在一艘行駛於海洋中央的大型貨船內部，要像以往的越獄完全不可能。

TITLE: Machete Kills
PLOT SUMMARY: Machete Cortezand agent Sartana Rivera attempt to arrest corrupt military members involved in a weapons deal with aMexican drug cartel group. The gangsters wipe out the military team, but they in turn are wiped by another party of masked men headed by aluchador-masked leader who kills Sartana. Machete is arrested and hanged by corrupt Sheriff Doakes and Deputy Clebourne. However, he survives the hanging and the officers receive a call from US President Rathcock. At theWhite House, Rathcock offers to wipe Machete's criminal record and grant him citizenship if he can confirm a threat from Marcos Mendez, a psychopath who wants to fire a nuclear missile atWashington, D.C.if the American government does not stop the cartels and the corrupt Mexican government. Machete travels toSan Antonio, where he meetshandlerandbeauty contestantBlanca Vasquez. AtAcapulcohe looks for Cereza, who can lead him to Mendez, but is attacked by brothel madam Desdemona, Cereza's mother. As Mendez's beloved virgin, Cereza warns Machete about Mendez'ssplit personality. As they travel to Mendez's headquarters, Mendez's enforcer Zaror receives a call from Mendez and shoots Cereza. Machete learns that Mendez has wired the missile's launch device to his own heart so that if he dies, the missile fires. Mendez kills the device's designer and activates its 24-hour timer. Killing Zaror along the way, Machete intends to escort Mendez to the US and find a way to disarm the missile. Mendez shares that he is a self-proclaimed secret agent who tried to expose his corrupt superiors, only to be betrayed and forced to watch his wife and family being tortured and killed, causing him to develop a split personality.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 该片承接《弯刀》故事，自从墨西哥人科尔特斯（丹尼·特乔）干掉德克萨斯州的黑帮之后，声名日隆，被美国总统任命为特使，负责追杀一个卡特尔组织从墨西哥越过边境来到美国的恐怖分子。
PLOT SUMMARY (HK): 該片承接《攞命．彎刀．罪惡城》故事，自從墨西哥人科爾特斯（丹尼·特喬）幹掉德克薩斯州的黑幫之後，聲名日隆，被美國總統任命為特使，負責追殺一個卡特爾組織從墨西哥越過邊境來到美國的恐怖分子。

TITLE: Dallas Buyers Club
PLOT SUMMARY: In 1985, promiscuousDallaselectrician and rodeo cowboyRon Woodroofis diagnosed withHIV/AIDSand told that he has about 30 days to live. At first, he refuses to accept the diagnosis until he remembers having unprotected sex with a prostitute who was anintravenous druguser. Woodroof's family and friends ostracize him, mistakenly assuming he contracted AIDS fromgay sex. He is fired from his job and evicted from his home. His doctor, Eve Saks, tells him anantiretroviral drugcalledzidovudine(AZT)—the only drug yet approved for testing in humanclinical trialsby theFDA—is thought to prolong the life of AIDS patients. Saks informs him that half of the trial patients receive the drug and the other half aplacebosince this is the only way to determine if the drug works. Woodroof bribes a hospital worker to get him AZT, which, exacerbated by hiscocaineandalcohol abuse, causes his health to deteriorate. Recuperating in the hospital, he meets Rayon, a drug-addicted, HIV-positivetrans womanhe is initially hostile toward. As his health worsens, he drives to a makeshift Mexican hospital to get more AZT. The facility is run by an American, Dr. Vass, whose medical license was revoked because his work with people with AIDS had violated US regulations. Vass warns Woodroof against AZT, telling him it is "poisonous." Instead, he prescribes a cocktail of drugs and nutritional supplements centered onddCand the proteinpeptide T, which are not yet approved for use in the United States by the FDA. Three months later, Woodroof finds his health much improved and realizes he could make money by importing the drugs and selling them to other HIV-positive patients. He is able to get the drugs over the border by masquerading as a priest with cancer and claiming they are for personal use. Dr. Saks starts to notice the adverse effects of AZT, but her supervisor, Dr. Sevard, tells her the trials cannot be discontinued. Woodroof starts selling the drugs in Dallas on the street, atgay nightclubs, anddiscothequebars. He reluctantly partners with Rayon since she can bring in more customers. The pair establishes the Dallas Buyers Club, charging $400 per month for membership and giving away the drugs to members to circumvent the laws that made it illegal to sell the drugs. The club is extremely popular, and Woodroof gradually begins to respect Rayon as a friend. When Woodroof is hospitalized for aheart attackcaused by an overdose of recently acquiredinterferonfrom Japan, Dr. Sevard learns of the club and its alternative drugs and is angry that the buyers club is interfering with his trial. The FDA confiscates the interferon and threatens to have Woodroof arrested. Dr. Saks agrees that there are benefits toclubsfor HIV drugs but feels powerless to change anything. The process the FDA uses to research, test, andapprove drugsis considered flawed and part of the problem for people suffering from AIDS. At that time, the United States and the FDA were particularly conservative by international standards in testing and approving anti-AIDS drugs. They were hostile to imported drugs to the point they were made contraband.Dr. Saks and Woodroof begin a friendship.
PLOT SUMMARY (CN): 1985年7月的达拉斯，性生活放荡的牛仔兼电工罗恩·伍德鲁夫被诊断出罹患艾滋病，只剩30天可活。身为异性恋者，罗恩·伍德鲁夫最初不接受诊断结果，但他回想起数年前曾和一位用静脉注射毒品的妓女进行过无套性交。罗恩·伍德鲁夫的家人和朋友误认为他受感染的原因是同性性行为，并因此排挤他，导致罗恩·伍德鲁夫被开除并被赶出家门。罗恩·伍德鲁夫到医院询问伊芙医师的建议，医师告诉他，美国食品药品监督管理局(FDA)正在测试一种叫齐多夫定(AZT）的药物，而且这是唯一获准的药物。但因尚处临床阶段，有一半的患者服用的是安慰剂。 罗恩·伍德鲁夫贿赂医院员工，借此获得齐多夫定(AZT)，但因为他同时也吸古柯碱，所以服药后病况并没有改善。当他回医院时，和他同病房的是吸毒成瘾、HIV检测结果为阳性的跨性别女子瑞恩。罗恩·伍德鲁夫起初对瑞恩满怀敌意，但随着健康状况恶化，他只能开车到墨西哥一家临时医院，试图获取更多AZT，此时正是第30天。该医院由维斯医师经营，维斯表示AZT有着会杀死免疫细胞的毒性，他开了美国没有核准的ddC和胜肽T给罗恩·伍德鲁夫。三个月后，罗恩·伍德鲁夫的健康状况大有改善，他便想转卖药物给其他患者来赚钱，因此他假扮神父，把三千多颗药丸带到美国，并谎称这些药物都是自用的。另一方面，伊芙医师开始注意到AZT的副作用，但她的主管赛瓦德医师不许她停止供药。 在接下来一年里，罗恩·伍德鲁夫在街头、同性恋酒吧和夜总会卖药。虽然他厌恶同性恋，但还是和瑞恩搭上线，希望她介绍更多客户。两人成立了“达拉斯买家俱乐部”，每月向会员收取400美金，并免费供给药物，这门生意十分成功，罗恩·伍德鲁夫也逐渐和瑞恩成为朋友。在罗恩·伍德鲁夫因为注射过量药物而心脏病发后，赛瓦德得知俱乐部和替代药物的事。FDA没收了罗恩·伍德鲁夫持有的两千瓶干扰素，并威胁要逮捕他，在赛瓦德质问伊芙时，伊芙肯定俱乐部带来的好处，之后伊芙也和罗恩·伍德鲁夫建立友谊。
